youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的辦簽證情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從打電話跟簽證中心確認準備清單（護照、二十六號申請表、兩張白底照片、身分證影本、機票、工作證明、六個月銀行紀錄）、一早到門口抽號碼牌 B27、聽到大廳叫錯號、到櫃檯繳一百四十美元規費拿收據 4407、拍照因為眨眼和頭髮被打斷重拍、十根手指按指紋、坐進九號窗口回答要去多倫多待十二天、工作證明少了英文翻譯趕去二樓翻譯件、留下護照選二十五美元快遞、拿到藍色回條寫著八個工作天、八月二十號星期四、快遞在八月二十一日星期五送到，一直到護照回到手上、簽證核准、十月五號起飛。全程 800 句，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Applying for a Visa phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — one traveler calls the visa center to build a document list, draws queue number B 27 at the door, hears the wrong number called, pays the 140 dollar fee at the cashier and takes receipt 4407, retakes the photo because he blinked and his hair covered one ear, presses all ten fingerprints, sits at window nine to answer where he is going and how long the trip lasts, runs to the translation desk for one missing page, hands over his passport and picks the courier, then waits eight working days for the answer written on the blue slip. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, I need help with my visa list.
dialogue.phonetic: /həˈloʊ aɪ nid hɛlp wɪð maɪ ˈvizə lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 喂，我想確認辦簽證要帶哪些文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, are you going there as a tourist?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ɑr ju ˈɡoʊɪŋ ðɛr æz ə ˈtʊrɪst./
dialogue.zh: 好啊，你是要去那邊觀光嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I am visiting my friend in Toronto.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ æm ˈvɪzɪtɪŋ maɪ frɛnd ɪn təˈrɑntoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 對，我去多倫多看朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a visitor visa is the right one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə ˈvɪzɪtər ˈvizə ɪz ðə raɪt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那觀光簽證就是你要的那一種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My letter says my interview is August ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlɛtər sɛz maɪ ˈɪntərˌvju ɪz ˈɔɡəst tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 通知信上寫我的面談是八月十號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a Monday, and the doors open early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ænd ðə dɔrz ˈoʊpən ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 那天是星期一，門開得很早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine fifteen in the morning, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn fɪfˈtin ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 早上九點十五分，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but please come fifteen minutes earlier.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt pliz kʌm fɪfˈtin ˈmɪnɪts ˈɜrliər./
dialogue.zh: 對，不過請你早十五分鐘到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly is the center?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪɡˈzæktli ɪz ðə ˈsɛntər./
dialogue.zh: 簽證中心到底在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tall building beside Exit two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɔl ˈbɪldɪŋ bəˈsaɪd ˈɛɡzɪt tu./
dialogue.zh: 二號出口旁邊那棟高樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which floor do I go to?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪʧ flɔr du aɪ ɡoʊ tu./
dialogue.zh: 我要去幾樓？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third floor, and take a number first.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd flɔr ænd teɪk ə ˈnʌmbər fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 三樓，到了先抽號碼牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, now the paper list on my desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ naʊ ðə ˈpeɪpər lɪst ɑn maɪ dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 好，現在看我桌上的紙本清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it aloud and I will check each line.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt əˈlaʊd ænd aɪ wɪl tʃɛk iʧ laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 你唸出來，我逐行幫你核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, the application form, number twenty-six.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst ði ˌæpləˈkeɪʃən fɔrm ˈnʌmbər ˈtwɛnti sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 首先，申請表，二十六號表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill it online, then print both sides.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪl ɪt ˈɑnˌlaɪn ðɛn prɪnt boʊθ saɪdz./
dialogue.zh: 線上填好，然後雙面列印。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sign it now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ saɪn ɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在就要簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with a black pen, no colors.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪð ə blæk pɛn noʊ ˈkʌlərz./
dialogue.zh: 要，用黑色筆，不要用彩色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the date at the bottom?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə deɪt æt ðə ˈbɑtəm./
dialogue.zh: 下面那一格要寫日期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Date it on the day you come here.
dialogue.phonetic: /deɪt ɪt ɑn ðə deɪ ju kʌm hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 到訪那天再填日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My passport is already on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpæspɔrt ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 我的護照已經擺在桌上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the last page for the end date.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə læst peɪdʒ fɔr ði ɛnd deɪt./
dialogue.zh: 翻到最後一頁看效期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is good until March twenty twenty-nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɡʊd ʌnˈtɪl mɑrʧ ˌtwɛnti ˌtwɛnti naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 有效期到 2029 年 3 月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that leaves more than six months.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðæt livz mɔr ðæn sɪks mʌnθs./
dialogue.zh: 很好，那樣還超過六個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need empty pages inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ˈɛmpli ˈpeɪdʒəz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 裡面要留有空白頁嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two clean pages for the stamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu klin ˈpeɪdʒəz fɔr ðə stæmp./
dialogue.zh: 要，兩頁空白讓人家蓋章。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two photos with a white background?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfoʊtoʊz wɪð ə waɪt ˈbækˌɡraʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 兩張白底照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and they must be recent ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðeɪ mʌst bi ˈrisənt wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 對，而且要最近拍的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I wear my glasses in them?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ wɛr maɪ ˈɡlæsɪz ɪn ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 拍照片時我可以戴眼鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No glasses, and no big smile either.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈɡlæsɪz ænd noʊ bɪɡ smaɪl ˈiðər./
dialogue.zh: 不能戴眼鏡，也不能大笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old ones from last year?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ oʊld wʌnz frʌm læst jɪr./
dialogue.zh: 可以用我去年的舊照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, take new photos this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ teɪk nu ˈfoʊtoʊz ðɪs wik./
dialogue.zh: 不行，這週先去重拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next, a copy of my ID card.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ə ˈkɑpi ʌv maɪ ˌaɪˈdi kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 接著是身分證影本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One side is enough, not the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn saɪd ɪz ɪˈnʌf nɑt ðə bæk./
dialogue.zh: 只印正面就好，背面不用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will use the copy machine downstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl juz ðə ˈkɑpi məˈʃin ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 我到樓下用影印機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, but bring the real card too.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn bʌt brɪŋ ðə ril kɑrd tu./
dialogue.zh: 好，不過身分證本體也要帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then my flight ticket, October five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn maɪ flaɪt ˈtɪkɪt ɑkˈtoʊbər faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 然後是我的機票，十月五號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Print the confirmation, not the phone screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɪnt ðə ˌkɑnfərˈmeɪʃən nɑt ðə foʊn skrin./
dialogue.zh: 把確認單印出來，不要只給手機畫面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is that message now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðæt ˈmɛsɪdʒ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那封通知訊息跑哪裡了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Search your inbox for the word confirm.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɜrʧ jɔr ˈɪnˌbɑks fɔr ðə wɜrd kənˈfɜrm./
dialogue.zh: 在收件匣用「確認」兩個字搜尋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, printed twice already.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt ˈprɪntɪd twaɪs ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 找到了，我已經印了兩份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, next is your job letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt nɛkst ɪz jɔr dʒɑb ˈlɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 很好，接下來是在職證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My company wrote it last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkʌmpəni roʊt ɪt læst mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 那張是我們公司上個月寫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It must show your title and your salary.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt mʌst ʃoʊ jɔr ˈtaɪtəl ænd jɔr ˈsæləri./
dialogue.zh: 上面要寫你的職位和薪資。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows both, with a red seal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃoʊz boʊθ wɪð ə rɛd sil./
dialogue.zh: 兩樣都有，還蓋了紅色的章。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, and does it list your leave days?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ænd dʌz ɪt lɪst jɔr liv deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 很好，那上面有寫準假幾天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not yet, I will ask them today.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt aɪ wɪl æsk ðəm təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 還沒有，我今天去問人事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask for one line about your return.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk fɔr wʌn laɪn əˈbaʊt jɔr rəˈtɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 請他們加一行，寫你會回國。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six months of bank records, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks mʌnθs ʌv bæŋk ˈrɛkərdz tu./
dialogue.zh: 也要六個月的銀行紀錄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the last six, printed from your bank app.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə læst sɪks ˈprɪntɪd frʌm jɔr bæŋk æp./
dialogue.zh: 要，最近六個月，從網路銀行印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also an invitation letter from Peter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ ən ˌɪnvəˈteɪʃən ˈlɛtər frʌm ˈpitər./
dialogue.zh: 還有彼得寫的邀請函。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, his address must be inside it.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hɪz əˈdrɛs mʌst bi ɪnˈsaɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，裡面一定要寫他的地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peter lives near the subway, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpitər lɪvz nɪr ðə ˈsʌbˌweɪ aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 彼得住在地鐵附近，我記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write his street on the form, line six.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hɪz strit ɑn ðə fɔrm laɪn sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 把他家門牌寫在表格第六行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Line six, I have it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪn sɪks aɪ hæv ɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 第六行，我這邊標起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not fold those pages, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt foʊld ðoʊz ˈpeɪdʒəz pliz./
dialogue.zh: 拜託不要把紙頁折到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything else for the folder?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls fɔr ðə ˈfoʊldər./
dialogue.zh: 文件夾裡還要放別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the money part is left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə ˈmʌni pɑrt ɪz lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 只剩下費用的那一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much do I owe at the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ du aɪ oʊ æt ðə ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 我到櫃台要繳多少規費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The visa fee is one hundred forty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈvizə fi ɪz wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 簽證規費是 140 美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will pay by card, is that fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl peɪ baɪ kɑrd ɪz ðæt faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我打算刷卡，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cards work at the counter, and cash too.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrdz wɜrk æt ðə ˈkaʊntər ænd kæʃ tu./
dialogue.zh: 櫃台收卡，也收現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No refund if they say no?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈriˌfʌnd ɪf ðeɪ seɪ noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 如果拒簽，錢不退嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, the fee stays with the center.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈrɛkt ðə fi steɪz wɪð ðə ˈsɛntər./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，規費不會退給申請人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I must keep that small paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ mʌst kip ðæt smɔl ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 那我得收好那張小票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, no receipt means no interview seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs noʊ riˈsit minz noʊ ˈɪntərˌvju sit./
dialogue.zh: 對，沒收據就不能進場面談。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many copies of everything?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈkɑpiz ʌv ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 每樣東西要幾份影本？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two copies, and bring the originals too.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈkɑpiz ænd brɪŋ ði ɔˈrɪdʒɪnəlz tu./
dialogue.zh: 兩份影本，正本也要帶著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing on my list here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ ɑn maɪ lɪst hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 清單上還有一樣東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which one, tell me the name.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪʧ wʌn tɛl mi ðə neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 哪一樣，唸給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Travel insurance for the twelve days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtrævəl ɪnˈʃʊrəns fɔr ðə twɛlv deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 十二天的旅遊平安保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, that paper helps at the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ðæt ˈpeɪpər hɛlps æt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 很好，窗口會看那一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I bought it late yesterday evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɔt ɪt leɪt ˈjɛstərˌdeɪ ˈivnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我昨天晚上很晚才買。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Print one page that shows the coverage.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɪnt wʌn peɪdʒ ðæt ʃoʊz ðə ˈkʌvərɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 把寫著保額的那頁印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many days do I write there?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni deɪz du aɪ raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我要在表格上寫幾天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve days, the same as your ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv deɪz ðə seɪm æz jɔr ˈtɪkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 十二天，跟機票上的日子一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, what should I not bring?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wɑt ʃʊd aɪ nɑt brɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 好，什麼東西不該帶去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No big bags, and no drinks inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bɪɡ bæɡz ænd noʊ drɪŋks ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 大包包和飲料都不能帶進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My backpack is already small.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbækˌpæk ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我的背包已經很小了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a thin folder is even better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə θɪn ˈfoʊldər ɪz ˈivən ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 那再配一個薄文件夾更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phones must be silent there?
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊnz mʌst bi ˈsaɪlənt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 手機要調成無聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Silent, and no calls in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaɪlənt ænd noʊ kɔlz ɪn ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 要無聲，大廳裡也不能講電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photography inside is not allowed?
dialogue.phonetic: /fəˈtɑɡrəfi ɪnˈsaɪd ɪz nɑt əˈlaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 裡面不能拍照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the fingerprint room hates cameras.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə ˈfɪŋɡərˌprɪnt rum heɪts ˈkæmərz./
dialogue.zh: 對，按指紋的房間最怕相機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who do I ask when I arrive?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu du aɪ æsk wɛn aɪ əˈraɪv./
dialogue.zh: 我到了現場要問誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The guard at the glass door, in blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡɑrd æt ðə ɡlæs dɔr ɪn blu./
dialogue.zh: 玻璃門口穿藍衣服的那位保全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue shirt, that is easy to spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu ʃɜrt ðæt ɪz ˈizi tu spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 藍色上衣，很好認。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He hands you a ticket for a seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi hændz ju ə ˈtɪkɪt fɔr ə sit./
dialogue.zh: 他會給你一張座位號碼牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A ticket like at the dentist?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtɪkɪt laɪk æt ðə ˈdɛntɪst./
dialogue.zh: 像看牙醫那種號碼牌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, one letter and two numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli wʌn ˈlɛtər ænd tu ˈnʌmbərz./
dialogue.zh: 就是那種，一個字母加兩個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I will build the folder tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ wɪl bɪld ðə ˈfoʊldər təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚我就把文件夾整理好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the list twice, then sleep well.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə lɪst twaɪs ðɛn slip wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 清單從頭核對兩遍，再去睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Passport, form, photos, letter, ticket, money.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpæspɔrt fɔrm ˈfoʊtoʊz ˈlɛtər ˈtɪkɪt ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 護照、表格、照片、證明、機票、費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a good list to wake up to.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ɡʊd lɪst tu weɪk ʌp tu./
dialogue.zh: 起床照這張清單做就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last doubt, may I call back?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst daʊt meɪ aɪ kɔl bæk./
dialogue.zh: 最後一個疑問，我可以再打來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the line is open till five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs ðə laɪn ɪz ˈoʊpən tɪl faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，服務專線開到五點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five o'clock, and your number is saved.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv əˈklɑk ænd jɔr ˈnʌmbər ɪz seɪvd./
dialogue.zh: 五點，你的號碼我存起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, see you Monday on the third floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd si ju ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ɑn ðə θɜrd flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 好，星期一我們三樓見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday August ten, I will be early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ˈɔɡəst tɛn aɪ wɪl bi ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 八月十號星期一，我會提早到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the folder and a calm heart.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə ˈfoʊldər ænd ə kɑm hɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 帶好文件夾，也把心放寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, I am here for nine fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ aɪ æm hɪr fɔr naɪn fɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 早安，我約的是九點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Visa people wait at the left corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvizə ˈpipəl weɪt æt ðə lɛft ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 辦簽證的在左邊那個角落排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the end of the line?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ði ɛnd ʌv ðə laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 這裡是隊伍的最後面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you are the last one now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ju ɑr ðə læst wʌn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 對，你現在排在最後一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only six people, that is good news.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli sɪks ˈpipəl ðæt ɪz ɡʊd nuz./
dialogue.zh: 只有六個人，算是好消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six today, and eleven on a Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks təˈdeɪ ænd ɪˈlɛvən ɑn ə ˈfraɪˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天六位，星期五會變成十一位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I show my letter first?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ʃoʊ maɪ ˈlɛtər fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我要先出示通知信嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show it, and your ID too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ ɪt ænd jɔr ˌaɪˈdi tu./
dialogue.zh: 給她看通知信，還有身分證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the paper, printed last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ðə ˈpeɪpər ˈprɪntɪd læst naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這是昨晚印好的那一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, keep it out until your turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn kip ɪt aʊt ʌnˈtɪl jɔr tɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 好，輪到你之前先拿著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take my coffee inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪk maɪ ˈkɔfi ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我可以帶咖啡進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No drinks past the glass door.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ drɪŋks pæst ðə ɡlæs dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 玻璃門裡面不能帶飲料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag is small, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ ɪz smɔl ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我的包包很小，能帶進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bags go under the seat, nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡz goʊ ˈʌndər ðə sit ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls./
dialogue.zh: 包包放在座位下面，其餘的都不准帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the number machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈnʌmbər məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 抽號碼的機器在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beside the plant, by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /bəˈsaɪd ðə plænt baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 就在大盆栽旁邊，靠窗那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I press the green part?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ prɛs ðə ɡrin pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 我按綠色那個地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it once, then wait for the sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ɪt wʌns ðɛn weɪt fɔr ðə saʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 按一次就好，等它嗶一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it goes, a thin white slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt ɡoʊz ə θɪn waɪt slɪp./
dialogue.zh: 吐出來了，一張薄薄的白單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it loud, what is your number?
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt laʊd wɑt ɪz jɔr ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 唸大聲一點，你的號碼是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: B twenty-seven, is that early?
dialogue.phonetic: /bi ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən ɪz ðæt ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: B27，這個號碼算早嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, the board is at B nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðə bɔrd ɪz æt bi naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，看板現在只叫到 B9。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So eighteen people are ahead of me?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˌeɪˈtin ˈpipəl ɑr əˈhɛd ʌv mi./
dialogue.zh: 也就是說我前面有十八個人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roughly, each one takes two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrʌfli iʧ wʌn teɪks tu ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 大約吧，一個人兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is nearly forty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈnɪrli ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 那將近要等四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down, the wait is calm today.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn ðə weɪt ɪz kɑm təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 先坐下，今天等得不兇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every seat is taken already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri sit ɪz ˈteɪkən ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 椅子全部都坐滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand by the pillar, you can see the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd baɪ ðə ˈpɪlər ju kæn si ðə bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 站在柱子旁邊，看得到號碼板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The air in here is very cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛr ɪn hɪr ɪz ˈvɛri koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 裡面的冷氣強得離譜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every room here is set too low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri rum hɪr ɪz sɛt tu loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這裡每個房間的冷氣都轉太低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hold my folder on my chest.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊld maɪ ˈfoʊldər ɑn maɪ tʃɛst./
dialogue.zh: 我把文件夾抱在胸前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, papers fly when you are nervous.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈpeɪpərz flaɪ wɛn ju ɑr ˈnɜrvəs./
dialogue.zh: 很好，緊張的時候紙張會飛掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The old lady cannot read the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði oʊld ˈleɪdi ˈkænɑt rid ðə bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 那位老奶奶看不懂號碼板上的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows letters, and they move fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃoʊz ˈlɛtərz ænd ðeɪ muv fæst./
dialogue.zh: 上面只有英文字母，而且跳得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will read it for her, line by line.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl rid ɪt fɜr hɜr laɪn baɪ laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我幫她唸，一行一行唸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You just became her favorite person here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ʤʌst bɪˈkeɪm hɜr ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈpɜrsən hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛變成她在這裡最喜歡的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen moved to B fourteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin muvd tu bi ˌfɔrˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕跳到 B14 了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more, then the line moves fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr ðɛn ðə laɪn muvz fæst./
dialogue.zh: 再兩個，隊伍就會很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes gone, still B sixteen?
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈmɪnɪts ɡɔn stɪl bi ˌsɪksˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 過了十二分鐘，還停在 B16？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the lady at B sixteen needs a copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈleɪdi æt bi sɪksˈtin nidz ə ˈkɑpi./
dialogue.zh: 對啊，B16 那位女士少一份影本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she go out to print it?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ʃi ɡoʊ aʊt tu prɪnt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 她出去列印了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is at the shop on the ground floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz æt ðə ʃɑp ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 她在一樓那間列印店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they keep her number?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðeɪ kip hɜr ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 她的號碼會保留嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but only for ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt ˈoʊnli fɔr tɛn ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 會，不過只留十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky she came early too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ʃi keɪm ˈɜrli tu./
dialogue.zh: 幸好她也提早來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Late people lose the number, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt ˈpipəl luz ðə ˈnʌmbər ˈɔlˌweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 遲到的人一定丟掉號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs are tired from standing.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɛɡz ɑr ˈtaɪərd frʌm ˈstændɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 站久了，我的腿有點酸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take that empty one, she just left.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðæt ˈɛmpti wʌn ʃi dʒʌst lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 坐那個空位，她剛離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, my legs needed this chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks maɪ lɛɡz ˈnidɪd ðɪs ʧɛr./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我的腿正好需要這張椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch the board, not your watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə bɔrd nɑt jɔr wɑtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 看著號碼板，不要一直看手錶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, that voice said B seventy-two.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðæt vɔɪs sɛd bi ˈsɛvənti tu./
dialogue.zh: 等等，那個聲音剛唸 B72。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the board shows B twenty-seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə bɔrd ʃoʊz bi ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 可是看板上顯示的是 B27。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lady beside me just stood up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪdi bəˈsaɪd mi dʒʌst stʊd ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 我旁邊那位小姐站起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her slip is C seventy-two, not B.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr slɪp ɪz si ˈsɛvənti tu nɑt bi./
dialogue.zh: 她的單子是 C72，不是 B。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So that call was for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðæt kɔl wʌz fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 所以剛剛那一叫是在叫我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think the machine read your digits backward.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ðə məˈʃin rɛd jɔr ˈdɪdʒɪts ˈbækwərd./
dialogue.zh: 我想機器把你的數字倒過來唸了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty-seven and seventy-two, easy mistake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən ænd ˈsɛvənti tu ˈizi mɪˈsteɪk./
dialogue.zh: 27 和 72，很容易搞錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counter three is calling, that is your slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntər θri ɪz ˈkɔlɪŋ ðæt ɪz jɔr slɪp./
dialogue.zh: 三號櫃台在叫了，叫的是你那張號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stand in that long line?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ stænd ɪn ðæt lɔŋ laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我要去排那條長隊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just walk over, they wait for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ʤʌst wɔk ˈoʊvər ðeɪ weɪt fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 不用排隊，直接走過去就好，他們在等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody called B twenty-seven again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊˌbɑdi kɔld bi ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 沒有人再叫第二次 B27。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The speaker here is broken half the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈspikər hɪr ɪz ˈbroʊkən hæf ðə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的播音器一天當中有半天是壞的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good thing you were standing next to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd θɪŋ ju wɜr ˈstændɪŋ nɛkst tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 還好我身邊正好站著你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have read this board ten times before.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv rɛd ðɪs bɔrd tɛn taɪmz bɪˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 這塊號碼板我已經幫人讀過十遍了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the real B seventy-two, where is he?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ril bi ˈsɛvənti tu wɛr ɪz hi./
dialogue.zh: 那真正的 B72 呢，人在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He came late, he is behind you now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi keɪm leɪt hi ɪz bɪˈhaɪnd ju naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 他遲到，現在就在你後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He looks calm about waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi lʊks kɑm əˈbaʊt ˈweɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 他看起來很能等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He brought a book, a very thick one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi brɔt ə bʊk ə ˈvɛri θɪk wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 他自帶了一本書，一本很厚的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, my folder is in my hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ maɪ ˈfoʊldər ɪz ɪn maɪ hænd./
dialogue.zh: 好，我文件夾已經拿在手上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counter three is the far one, see the sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntər θri ɪz ðə fɑr wʌn si ðə saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 三號櫃台在最裡面，看到牌子沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see the blue sign, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ðə blu saɪn θæŋk ju./
dialogue.zh: 我看到那塊藍色牌子了，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show the slip and your letter together.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ ðə slɪp ænd jɔr ˈlɛtər təˈɡɛðər./
dialogue.zh: 把號碼牌和通知信一起遞過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wall says fees change each January.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔl sɛz fiz tʃeɪndʒ iʧ ˈdʒænjʊˌɛri./
dialogue.zh: 牆上寫規費每年一月調整。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours is still one hundred forty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ɪz stɪl wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 你那張還是 140 美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my money plan still works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd maɪ ˈmʌni plæn stɪl wɜrks./
dialogue.zh: 好，那我準備的錢還夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cashier line is short, go first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæˈʃɪr laɪn ɪz ʃɔrt goʊ fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 繳費那條隊伍很短，先過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a mirror by that door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈmɪrər baɪ ðæt dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 那扇門邊有一面鏡子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fix your hair, the photo comes later.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪks jɔr hɛr ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ kʌmz ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 整理一下頭髮，等等要拍照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair is flat already, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛr ɪz flæt ɔlˈrɛdi ˈsædli./
dialogue.zh: 很可惜，我的頭髮本來就扁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat hair is fine, a clean face matters.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt hɛr ɪz faɪn ə klin feɪs ˈmætərz./
dialogue.zh: 頭髮扁沒關係，臉要乾淨才要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water fountain is broken, great.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔtər ˈfaʊntən ɪz ˈbroʊkən ɡreɪt./
dialogue.zh: 飲水機壞了，真妙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No water before the fingerprints, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɔtər bəˈfɔr ðə ˈfɪŋɡərˌprɪnts ˈæktʃuəli./
dialogue.zh: 其實按指紋之前不能喝水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not, my fingers get dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ nɑt maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz ɡɛt draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 為什麼不行，我的手指容易乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry skin prints badly, they will wipe them.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ skɪn prɪnts ˈbædli ðeɪ wɪl waɪp ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 皮膚太乾按不清楚，他們會幫你擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A wet wipe, that sounds strange.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɛt waɪp ðæt saʊndz streɪndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 濕濕的紙巾，聽起來有點怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes two minutes, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt teɪks tu ˈmɪnɪts du nɑt ˈwɜri./
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘就好，先別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is the young man at desk two?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz ðə jʌŋ mæn æt dɛsk tu./
dialogue.zh: 二號桌那位年輕人在做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He checks papers before the counter line.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi tʃɛks ˈpeɪpərz bəˈfɔr ðə ˈkaʊntər laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 他在隊伍前先幫你預審文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he look at my folder yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd hi lʊk æt maɪ ˈfoʊldər jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 他已經看過我的文件夾了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, counter three calls you first.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt ˈkaʊntər θri kɔlz ju fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 還沒有，三號櫃台會先叫你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone is arguing near the exit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn ɪz ˈɑrɡjuɪŋ nɪr ðə ˈɛɡzɪt./
dialogue.zh: 有人在出口那裡吵了起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A man came without an appointment letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə mæn keɪm wɪˈðaʊt ən əˈpɔɪntmənt ˈlɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 一位先生沒帶預約信就跑來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They will not let him in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl nɑt lɛt hɪm ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 他們不讓他進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He must book a new day online.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi mʌst bʊk ə nu deɪ ˈɑnˌlaɪn./
dialogue.zh: 他得在線上重新約一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glad my paper is printed twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæd maɪ ˈpeɪpər ɪz ˈprɪntɪd twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 還好我的通知信印了兩份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. The board is at B twenty-four now.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ðə bɔrd ɪz æt bi ˈtwɛnti fɔr naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 聰明。看板現在到 B24 了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three more people, my hands are cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri mɔr ˈpipəl maɪ hændz ɑr koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 再三個人，我的手好冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub them, the scanner needs warm skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌb ðɛm ðə ˈskænər nidz wɔrm skɪn./
dialogue.zh: 搓一搓，掃指紋的機器要暖皮膚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, counter three at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz ˈkaʊntər θri æt læst./
dialogue.zh: 到了，終於來到三號櫃台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go on, desk three is free now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ɑn dɛsk θri ɪz fri naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 去吧，三號櫃台現在空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, here is my slip and letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ hɪr ɪz maɪ slɪp ænd ˈlɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 早安，這是我的號碼牌和通知信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, B twenty-seven, that is you.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju bi ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən ðæt ɪz ju./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，B27，就是你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is my number, my name is Lin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈnʌmbər maɪ neɪm ɪz lɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那個號碼是我的，我姓林。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, let me check the name.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tu miːt ju lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 幸會，我核對一下名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My name is on the passport, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm ɪz ɑn ðə ˈpæspɔrt tu./
dialogue.zh: 護照上也有我的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spell the middle part for me, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /spɛl ðə ˈmɪdəl pɑrt fɔr mi pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請唸中間那段字母給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just one word, there is no middle name.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn wɜrd ðɛr ɪz noʊ ˈmɪdəl neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 只有單名，沒有名字中間那段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then the file is easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn ðə faɪl ɪz ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 好，那建檔就簡單了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my form number twenty-six correct?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ fɔrm ˈnʌmbər ˈtwɛnti sɪks kəˈrɛkt./
dialogue.zh: 我填的二十六號表格是對的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, all the lines are filled in.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɔl ðə laɪnz ɑr fɪld ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 對，每一格都有填寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay now, before the interview?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ naʊ bəˈfɔr ði ˈɪntərˌvju./
dialogue.zh: 我現在就要繳費，在面談之前嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always first, then the photo room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌweɪz fɜrst ðɛn ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ rum./
dialogue.zh: 一定先繳費，再去拍照間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fee is one hundred forty dollars?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fi ɪz wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 規費是 140 美元對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, no extra cost this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt noʊ ˈɛkstrə kɔst ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，今天早上沒有任何額外費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my card, the blue one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz maɪ kɑrd ðə blu wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這是我的卡，藍色那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, the card line is down today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri ðə kɑrd laɪn ɪz daʊn təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，今天刷卡系統掛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down since when, this morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn sɪns wɛn ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 掛了多久，從早上開始嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Since eight, the bank is fixing it.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪns eɪt ðə bæŋk ɪz ˈfɪksɪŋ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 從八點就不通，銀行在修。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I must use cash now.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ mʌst juz kæʃ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 所以我現在只能用現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have bills on you?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv bɪlz ɑn ju./
dialogue.zh: 你身上有紙幣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have one hundred fifty in my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɪfti ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我口袋裡有 150 美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will give you ten back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ wɪl ɡɪv ju tɛn bæk./
dialogue.zh: 剛好，我找你 10 美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need the exact amount?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ði ɪɡˈzækt əˈmaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 我一定要準備剛好的金額嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we give change at this window.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wi ɡɪv tʃeɪndʒ æt ðɪs ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不用，這個窗口會找錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, take the clean new bills.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr teɪk ðə klin nu bɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 給你，這些是嶄新的紙幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I count it in front of you.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju aɪ kaʊnt ɪt ɪn frʌnt ʌv ju./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我當面數給你聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And ten dollars back to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd tɛn ˈdɑlərz bæk tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 然後找我 10 美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, here, and fold it carefully.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hɪr ænd foʊld ɪt ˈkɛrfəli./
dialogue.zh: 對，拿好，小心地摺起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, what is this small paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wɑt ɪz ðɪs smɔl ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 那這一張小紙是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is your receipt, number four four oh seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz jɔr riˈsit ˈnʌmbər fɔr fɔr oʊ ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 這是你的收據，號碼 4407。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four four oh seven, I write it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr fɔr oʊ ˈsɛvən aɪ raɪt ɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 4407，我把它抄下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, no second copy if you lose it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd noʊ ˈsɛkənd ˈkɑpi ɪf ju luz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好，弄丟了就沒有第二張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is scary, I keep it inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈskɛri aɪ kip ɪt ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 聽好可怕，我收進內頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Staple it to your letter, right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsteɪpəl ɪt tu jɔr ˈlɛtər raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 用釘書機釘在通知信上，就那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I show it at the window?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ʃoʊ ɪt æt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 到窗口我要拿出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the officer wants it first.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ði ˈɔfəsər wɑnts ɪt fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 要，簽證官第一個看的就是它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which window is mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪʧ ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我的是哪一個窗口？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Window nine, after the photo room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪndoʊ naɪn ˈæftər ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ rum./
dialogue.zh: 九號窗口，拍完照之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine, I will look for nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn aɪ wɪl lʊk fɔr naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 九號，我會找九號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big signs hang above the counters.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ saɪnz hæŋ əˈbʌv ðə ˈkaʊntərz./
dialogue.zh: 大大的牌子掛在櫃台上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the receipt have a date?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə riˈsit hæv ə deɪt./
dialogue.zh: 收據上有寫日期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today's date, Monday August ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuˈdeɪz deɪt ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ˈɔɡəst tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 今天的日期，八月十號星期一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, the date is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ðə deɪt ɪz raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 很好，日期沒錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We check that twice, it matters later.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tʃɛk ðæt twaɪs ɪt ˈmætərz ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 我們會核對兩遍，之後要用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I lose this today?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪf aɪ luz ðɪs təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 如果我今天把它弄丟了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then look it up online with the number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lʊk ɪt ʌp ˈɑnˌlaɪn wɪð ðə ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 那就用那個號碼在網上查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Online, with four four oh seven?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɑnˈlaɪn wɪð fɔr fɔr oʊ ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 在網上用 4407 查嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the website knows your file.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈwɛbˌsaɪt noʊz jɔr faɪl./
dialogue.zh: 對，網站會顯示你的檔案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, then I can stop worrying.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðɛn aɪ kæn stɑp ˈwɜriɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 好，那我就不用一直擔心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people fear losing that slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl fɪr ˈluzɪŋ ðæt slɪp./
dialogue.zh: 多數人都怕搞丟那張單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there anything else to pay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls tu peɪ./
dialogue.zh: 還有別的費用要繳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you want the fast service.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ju wɑnt ðə fæst ˈsɜrvɪs./
dialogue.zh: 只有你要快速件的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fast service, how fast?
dialogue.phonetic: /fæst ˈsɜrvɪs haʊ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 快速件，能多快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days instead of eight, at eighty more.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz ɪnˈstɛd ʌv eɪt æt ˈeɪti mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 八個工作天變成兩天，但要多付 80 美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eighty dollars on top of one forty?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪti ˈdɑlərz ɑn tɑp ʌv wʌn ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 在 140 之上再加 80 美元？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and your trip is far away.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd jɔr trɪp ɪz fɑr əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，而且你的行程還早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then standard is fine for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈstændərd ɪz faɪn fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 那標準件對我來說就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, the normal wait is eight working days.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ðə ˈnɔrməl weɪt ɪz eɪt ˈwɜrkɪŋ deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，一般要等八個工作天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight days, that is not long.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt deɪz ðæt ɪz nɑt lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 八個工作天，不算久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your flight is October five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd jɔr flaɪt ɪz ɑkˈtoʊbər faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 而你的機票是十月五號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, almost eight weeks away.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈɔlmoʊst eɪt wikz əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 對，還有差不多八週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plenty of time, do not rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈplɛnti ʌv taɪm du nɑt rʌʃ./
dialogue.zh: 時間很充裕，別著急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One question about the money.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 還有一個關於費用的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask, I know the price list well.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk aɪ noʊ ðə praɪs lɪst wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 你問吧，價目表我很熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do children pay the same fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈtʃɪldrən peɪ ðə seɪm fi./
dialogue.zh: 小孩也要繳一樣的規費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, under six pays nothing at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈʌndər sɪks peɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 不用，六歲以下完全免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cousin has a small boy, good news.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkʌzən hæz ə smɔl bɔɪ ɡʊd nuz./
dialogue.zh: 我表妹有個小兒子，這消息真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She should start her list the same way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ʃʊd stɑrt hɜr lɪst ðə seɪm weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 她也可以照樣先列一張清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the fee written on my slip?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə fi ˈrɪtən ɑn maɪ slɪp./
dialogue.zh: 我的單子上印有金額嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, one forty, in bold letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk wʌn ˈfɔrti ɪn boʊld ˈlɛtərz./
dialogue.zh: 你看，140，粗體大字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bold letters help tired eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊld ˈlɛtərz hɛlp ˈtaɪərd aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 粗體字對累壞的眼睛很友善。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We print big on purpose here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi prɪnt bɪɡ ɑn ˈpɜrpəs hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我們在這裡故意印得很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, is my file open already?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪz maɪ faɪl ˈoʊpən ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 那我的檔案已經建立了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It opens today, one page for each.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈoʊpənz təˈdeɪ wʌn peɪʤ fɔr iʧ./
dialogue.zh: 今天就開檔，一份文件掃成一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scanned, not photocopied?
dialogue.phonetic: /skænd nɑt ˈfoʊtoʊˌkɑpid./
dialogue.zh: 是掃描，不是影印嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scanned, so the office abroad can read it.
dialogue.phonetic: /skænd soʊ ði ˈɔfɪs əˈbrɔd kæn rid ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 掃描，讓國外的辦公室也能看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Abroad, so they are the ones deciding?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbrɔd soʊ ðeɪ ɑr ðə wʌnz dəˈsaɪdɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 在國外，所以是那邊的人在決定？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we only take your papers here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi ˈoʊnli teɪk jɔr ˈpeɪpərz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 對，我們在這裡只收件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That explains the slow mail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz ðə sloʊ meɪl./
dialogue.zh: 那就難怪信件走得那麼慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is email, not mail, don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈimel nɑt meɪl doʊnt ˈwɜri./
dialogue.zh: 其實是電子郵件，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They will email the answer?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl ˈimel ði ˈænsər./
dialogue.zh: 他們會用郵件回覆結果嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually, and then the passport moves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuːʒəwəli ænd ðɛn ðə ˈpæspɔrt muvz./
dialogue.zh: 通常會，接著你的護照就會被送走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Moves where, back to this counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /muvz wɛr bæk tu ðɪs ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 移動到哪裡，回到這個櫃台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To the desk you visit later today.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ðə dɛsk ju ˈvɪzɪt ˈleɪtər təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 到你待會兒會去的那張桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The courier desk, I heard that name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʊriər dɛsk aɪ hɜrd ðæt neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 快遞櫃台，我聽過這個名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone will explain it after the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn wɪl ɪkˈspleɪn ɪt ˈæftər ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 面談之後會有人跟你說明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, so first the photo room.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ soʊ fɜrst ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ rum./
dialogue.zh: 好，所以先拍照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, go through the green door behind you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɡoʊ θru ðə ɡrin dɔr bəˈhaɪnd ju./
dialogue.zh: 對，從你後面那扇綠門進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The green one with the tall plant?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrin wʌn wɪð ðə tɔl plænt./
dialogue.zh: 那扇旁邊有高植物的綠門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one, turn left inside, room B.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn tɜrn lɛft ɪnˈsaɪd rum bi./
dialogue.zh: 就是那扇，進去左轉，B 室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room B, do I wait there?
dialogue.phonetic: /rum bi du aɪ weɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: B 室，我要在那裡等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two seats only, the line is short.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu sits ˈoʊnli ðə laɪn ɪz ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 只有兩個座位，隊伍不長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love the word short this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ðə wɜrd ʃɔrt ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我今早最喜歡的就是短這個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You have taken forty minutes so far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæv ˈteɪkən ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnɪts soʊ fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 你到目前為止花了四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty minutes, and I am still calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnɪts ænd aɪ æm stɪl kɑm./
dialogue.zh: 四十分鐘，我還能保持冷靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, calm hands print better later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɑm hændz prɪnt ˈbɛtər ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 很好，手不抖等等按得比較清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Print? I thought you meant photos.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɪnt aɪ θɔt ju mɛnt ˈfoʊtoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 按？我以為你說的是拍照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, the camera and the finger glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ðə ˈkæmərə ænd ðə ˈfɪŋɡər ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 兩樣都有，相機和掃指紋的玻璃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The finger glass, that sounds new to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɪŋɡər ɡlæs ðæt saʊndz nu tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 掃指紋的玻璃板，聽起來很新奇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes one minute, go and see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt teɪks wʌn ˈmɪnɪt ɡoʊ ænd si./
dialogue.zh: 一分鐘就好，過去看看吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room B, hello, I am here for the photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum bi həˈloʊ aɪ æm hɪr fɔr ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ./
dialogue.zh: B 室，你好，我來拍照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sit on the low stool, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs sɪt ɑn ðə loʊ stul pliz./
dialogue.zh: 好，請坐那張矮椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This stool is very low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs stul ɪz ˈvɛri loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這張椅子真的很矮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The camera sits high, so it looks down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈkæmərə sɪts haɪ soʊ ɪt lʊks daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 相機架得高，所以是由上往下看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stand or stay seated?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ stænd ɔr steɪ ˈsitɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我要站起來還是坐著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seated, chin on the paper rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsitɪd tʃɪn ɑn ðə ˈpeɪpər rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 坐著，下巴擱在紙墊上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The paper there looks clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈpeɪpər ðɛr lʊks klin./
dialogue.zh: 那張紙看起來很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We change it for every person.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tʃeɪndʒ ɪt fɔr ˈɛvri ˈpɜrsən./
dialogue.zh: 每一個人我們都換新的一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I take my glasses off now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ teɪk maɪ ˈɡlæsɪz ɔf naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在要把眼鏡摘下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the glass catches light and shines.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ɡlæs ˈkæʧɪz laɪt ænd ʃaɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 要，鏡片會反光，會出現亮塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I put them, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ pʊt ðɛm ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那我把眼鏡放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The case is on the shelf, not your pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə keɪs ɪz ɑn ðə ʃɛlf nɑt jɔr ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 盒子在架子上，不要塞進褲子口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, no glasses, I am ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ noʊ ˈɡlæsɪz aɪ æm ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 好，不戴眼鏡，我準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the small round light.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə smɔl raʊnd laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 看著那顆小小的圓燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tiny yellow one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaɪni ˈjɛloʊ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那顆小小的黃燈嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one, keep your eyes on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn kip jɔr aɪz ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 就是那顆，眼睛別離開它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like watching a bird feeder?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ˈwɑʧɪŋ ə bɜrd ˈfidər./
dialogue.zh: 像盯著餵鳥器那樣專心？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, but do not smile this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli bʌt du nɑt smaɪl ðɪs taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，不過這一次不要笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I promise, my mouth stays shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈprɑmɪs maɪ maʊθ steɪz ʃʌt./
dialogue.zh: 我保證，嘴巴緊緊閉著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nervous people always smile at me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɜrvəs ˈpipəl ˈɔlˌweɪz smaɪl æt mi./
dialogue.zh: 緊張的人總是對著我笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you know I am nervous?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪd ju noʊ aɪ æm ˈnɜrvəs./
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼知道我緊張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your hands hold the folder too tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr hændz hoʊld ðə ˈfoʊldər tu taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你的手把文件夾抓得太緊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I will relax my hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri aɪ wɪl rɪˈlæks maɪ hændz./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我把手放鬆一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, one breath, then the click.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wʌn brɛθ ðɛn ðə klɪk./
dialogue.zh: 很好，吸一口氣，然後會喀嚓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That click is very loud!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt klɪk ɪz ˈvɛri laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 那聲喀嚓真的好大聲！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The old camera is honest, not quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði oʊld ˈkæmərə ɪz ˈɑnɪst nɑt ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 這台舊相機很誠實，就是不安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honest? You mean it shows too much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəst ju min ɪt ʃoʊz tu mʌʧ./
dialogue.zh: 誠實？你是說它拍得太清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows every hair and every line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃoʊz ˈɛvri hɛr ænd ˈɛvri laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 每一根頭髮、每一條紋路都拍得見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do not show me that screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du nɑt ʃoʊ mi ðæt skrin./
dialogue.zh: 拜託別給我看那個螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too late, look, you blinked in both.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu leɪt lʊk ju blɪŋkt ɪn boʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 太慢了，你看，兩張都眨眼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both photos? Then take a third.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ˈfoʊtoʊz ðɛn teɪk ə θɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 兩張都閉眼？那再拍第三張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I was going to say the same thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu seɪ ðə seɪm θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我本來也打算這樣提。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more try, eyes wide open.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr traɪ aɪz waɪd ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 再試一次，眼睛睜大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, your hair covers one ear.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt jɔr hɛr ˈkʌvərz wʌn ɪr./
dialogue.zh: 等等，你的頭髮蓋住一邊耳朵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This side? I push it back now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs saɪd aɪ pʊʃ ɪt bæk naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這一邊嗎？我現在往後撥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better, both ears show, very good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər boʊθ ɪrz ʃoʊ ˈvɛri ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 好多了，兩邊耳朵都露出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ears matter on a visa photo?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪrz ˈmætər ɑn ə ˈvizə ˈfoʊtoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 簽證照片也要管耳朵嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four rules: ears, chin, mouth, hair.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr rulz ɪrz tʃɪn maʊθ hɛr./
dialogue.zh: 四條規則：耳朵、下巴、嘴巴、頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four rules, I broke two of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr rulz aɪ broʊk tu ʌv ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 四條規則我壞了兩條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone breaks one, it is normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn breɪks wʌn ɪt ɪz ˈnɔrməl./
dialogue.zh: 人人都會犯一條，這很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The flash again, hold still now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flæʃ əˈɡɛn hoʊld stɪl naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 又要閃光了，我乖乖坐好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, this one is sharp and calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ðɪs wʌn ɪz ʃɑrp ænd kɑm./
dialogue.zh: 好了，這張清楚又平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the background clean this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈbækˌɡraʊnd klin ðɪs taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 這次的背景乾淨了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean white, no shadow on your neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin waɪt noʊ ˈʃædoʊ ɑn jɔr nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的白色，脖子上也沒有影子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My neck had a shadow before?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ nɛk hæd ə ˈʃædoʊ bəˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我脖子剛剛有影子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small one, so move up a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl wʌn soʊ muv ʌp ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 有一點，所以請你往前坐一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like this chair, it is soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðɪs tʃɛr ɪt ɪz sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡這張椅子，坐起來很軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit for the fingers now, same chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt fɔr ðə ˈfɪŋɡərz naʊ seɪm tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 現在換按指紋，椅子不用換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All ten fingers, one by one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl tɛn ˈfɪŋɡərz wʌn baɪ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 十根手指，一根一根來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right hand first, four flat fingers.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hænd fɜrst fɔr flæt ˈfɪŋɡərz./
dialogue.zh: 先右手，四根手指平放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flat, like this, on the glass?
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt laɪk ðɪs ɑn ðə ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 平平地，像這樣，壓在玻璃上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, press but do not push hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs prɛs bʌt du nɑt pʊʃ hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 對，要壓但不要使力推。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It beeped, is that a good sound?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt bipt ɪz ðæt ə ɡʊd saʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 它嗶了一聲，那是好聲音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A good beep means the print is clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡʊd bip minz ðə prɪnt ɪz klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 嗶一聲代表按得清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three more on this hand, then the thumb.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri mɔr ɑn ðɪs hænd ðɛn ðə θʌm./
dialogue.zh: 這隻手再三根，然後是大拇指。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The thumb is the hard one, roll it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə θʌm ɪz ðə hɑrd wʌn roʊl ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 大拇指最難，要輕輕滾一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Roll, like opening a jar?
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊl laɪk ˈoʊpənɪŋ ə dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 滾動，像轉開罐頭那樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly like that, you learn fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk ðæt ju lɜrn fæst./
dialogue.zh: 就是那樣，你學得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that beep came again.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt bip keɪm əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 好，那聲嗶又來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five on the right, now your left hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ɑn ðə raɪt naʊ jɔr lɛft hænd./
dialogue.zh: 右手五根完成了，換左手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left hand, same order, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft hænd seɪm ˈɔrdər raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 左手，順序一樣，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four first, thumb last, same as before.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr fɜrst θʌm læst seɪm æz bəˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 先四根，最後大拇指，跟剛剛一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This finger feels stuck, hmm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈfɪŋɡər filz stʌk hʌm./
dialogue.zh: 這根手指有點卡卡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It failed twice, it is too dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt feɪld twaɪs ɪt ɪz tu draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 它失敗兩次，皮膚太乾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry again, the cold room did it.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ əˈɡɛn ðə koʊld rum dɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 又乾了，是這間的冷氣害的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it on the warm cloth, here.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɪt ɑn ðə wɔrm klɔθ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 用那條溫的布擦一下，給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That cloth smells like soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt klɔθ smɛlz laɪk soʊp./
dialogue.zh: 那塊布聞起來像肥皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soap, warm water, patience, then press.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊp wɔrm ˈwɔtər ˈpeɪʃəns ðɛn prɛs./
dialogue.zh: 肥皂、溫水、耐心，然後按下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I waited a full ten seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈweɪtɪd ə fʊl tɛn ˈsɛkəndz./
dialogue.zh: 我等了整整十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now it took the print at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ ɪt tʊk ðə prɪnt æt læst./
dialogue.zh: 好，這下終於收到清楚的指紋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only one finger left, the thumb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wʌn ˈfɪŋɡər lɛft ðə θʌm./
dialogue.zh: 只剩一根，大拇指。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll it slow, you did it well before.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊl ɪt sloʊ ju dɪd ɪt wɛl bəˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢滾，你剛剛右手做得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten beeps, is that everything?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn bips ɪz ðæt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 十聲嗶，這樣就全部完成了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more thing, sign the small pad.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ saɪn ðə smɔl pæd./
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，在小板上簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My name, on that glass thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm ɑn ðæt ɡlæs θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我的名字，寫在那個玻璃板上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the pen, write it like your passport.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə pɛn raɪt ɪt laɪk jɔr ˈpæspɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 用那支筆，照護照上的寫法簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same spelling, same letters, fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈspɛlɪŋ seɪm ˈlɛtərz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 同樣的拼法、同樣的字，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I print the check sheet for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ prɪnt ðə tʃɛk ʃit fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 現在我印一張核對表給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A paper with my face and prints?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpeɪpər wɪð maɪ feɪs ænd prɪnts./
dialogue.zh: 一張有我的臉和指紋的紙？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, and tell me if the name is wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ænd tɛl mi ɪf ðə neɪm ɪz rɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 看看，名字錯了要告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The name is right, the face is mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə neɪm ɪz raɪt ðə feɪs ɪz maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 名字對了，臉也是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some people say the camera stole their face.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˈpipəl seɪ ðə ˈkæmərə stoʊld ðɛr feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 有人會說相機把他們的臉偷走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, I just look tired in print.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪ dʒʌst lʊk ˈtaɪərd ɪn prɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 不會，我只是印出來顯得累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tired faces pass every single day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪərd ˈfeɪsɪz pæs ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 疲倦的臉每天都能過關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I keep this sheet with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ kip ðɪs ʃit wɪð mi./
dialogue.zh: 這張核對表我要自己收著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it goes into your file, not you.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ɡoʊz ˈɪntu jɔr faɪl nɑt ju./
dialogue.zh: 不用，它進你的檔案，不給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my two printed photos?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd maɪ tu ˈprɪntɪd ˈfoʊtoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 那洗出來的兩張照片呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One stays, one goes home with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn steɪz wʌn ɡoʊz hoʊm wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 一張留下來，一張讓你帶回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will hide mine, my mother laughs.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl haɪd maɪn maɪ ˈmʌðər læfs./
dialogue.zh: 我會把那張收好，我媽會笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mothers always laugh at visa faces.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌðərz ˈɔlˌweɪz læf æt ˈvizə ˈfeɪsɪz./
dialogue.zh: 媽媽們看到辦簽證的臉都會笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long did the whole room take?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dɪd ðə hoʊl rum teɪk./
dialogue.zh: 這一間總共花了多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six minutes, your fastest stop today.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmɪnɪts jɔr ˈfæstɪst stɑp təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 六分鐘，是你今天走得最快的一站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six is better than forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz ˈbɛtər ðæn ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 六分鐘比四十分鐘好太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now window nine, the officer is waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ˈwɪndoʊ naɪn ði ˈɔfəsər ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 現在去九號窗口，簽證官在等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I take the folder and the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ teɪk ðə ˈfoʊldər ænd ðə riˈsit./
dialogue.zh: 文件夾和收據我都要帶著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, and your number four four oh seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ænd jɔr ˈnʌmbər fɔr fɔr oʊ ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 都帶，還有你的號碼 4407。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four four oh seven, I know it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr fɔr oʊ ˈsɛvən aɪ noʊ ɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 4407，我現在記熟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The door at the end, count the windows.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔr æt ði ɛnd kaʊnt ðə ˈwɪndoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 走到最後那扇門，一路數窗口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven, eight, nine, here I come.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən eɪt naɪn hɪr aɪ kʌm./
dialogue.zh: 七、八、九，我來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good luck, she is fair but very strict.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd lʌk ʃi ɪz fɛr bʌt ˈvɛri strɪkt./
dialogue.zh: 祝你好運，她很公道但非常嚴格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Window nine, good morning, ma'am.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪndoʊ naɪn ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ mæm./
dialogue.zh: 九號窗口。早安，女士。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good morning, sit down and slide the folder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ sɪt daʊn ænd slaɪd ðə ˈfoʊldər./
dialogue.zh: 早安，坐下來把文件夾推給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, everything is in order.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɪz ɪn ˈɔrdər./
dialogue.zh: 給你，裡面都照順序排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Receipt first, please, with the number.
dialogue.phonetic: /riˈsit fɜrst pliz wɪð ðə ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 請先給我收據，上面有號碼那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four four oh seven, it is on the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr fɔr oʊ ˈsɛvən ɪt ɪz ɑn ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 4407，就在最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the fee date is today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðə fi deɪt ɪz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 對，繳費日期就是今天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paid at counter three, this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪd æt ˈkaʊntər θri ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 今天早上在三號櫃台繳的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now your passport, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ jɔr ˈpæspɔrt pliz./
dialogue.zh: 好，現在請給我護照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is valid until March twenty twenty-nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈvæləd ʌnˈtɪl mɑrʧ ˌtwɛnti ˌtwɛnti naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 效期到 2029 年 3 月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More than six months, that is plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr ðæn sɪks mʌnθs ðæt ɪz ˈplɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 超過六個月的效期，非常夠用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my old passport too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid maɪ oʊld ˈpæspɔrt tu./
dialogue.zh: 舊護照也要交出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only the one you will travel on.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈoʊnli ðə wʌn ju wɪl ˈtrævəl ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 不用，只要你要出國的那一本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just this blue one, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðɪs blu wʌn ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那就只有這本藍色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me your date of birth, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi jɔr deɪt ʌv bɜrθ pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請說出你的出生年月日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: March twelve, nineteen ninety.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑrʧ twɛlv ˌnaɪnˈtin ˈnɪnti./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve, yes, it matches the form.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv jɛs ɪt ˈmætʃɪz ðə fɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 十二日，沒錯，跟表格一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I filled that line twice, carefully.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fɪld ðæt laɪn twaɪs ˈkɛrfəli./
dialogue.zh: 那一欄我小心地寫了兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now look at the camera for one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lʊk æt ðə ˈkæmərə fɔr wʌn ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 現在看著鏡頭一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Again? Room B took my photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɛn rum bi tʊk maɪ ˈfoʊtoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 又要拍？B 室已經拍過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one stays on my screen, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn steɪz ɑn maɪ skrin ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 這張只留在我的螢幕上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I look straight ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn aɪ lʊk streɪt əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 好，我直視前方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, and your fingerprints are clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ænd jɔr ˈfɪŋɡərˌprɪnts ɑr klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 很好，你的指紋也很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The left thumb was a hard fight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɛft θʌm wʌz ə hɑrd faɪt./
dialogue.zh: 左手大拇指真的很難按。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see all ten, so it worked.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɔl tɛn soʊ ɪt wɜrkt./
dialogue.zh: 十個我都看到了，所以成功了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That warm cloth on the table saved me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɔrm klɔθ ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl seɪvd mi./
dialogue.zh: 桌上那條溫布救了我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm hands print well, cold hands do not.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm hændz prɪnt wɛl koʊld hændz du nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 手暖就按得好，手冷就不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, I will bring gloves next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ɡlʌvz nɛkst taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 記下了，下次我戴手套來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the easy questions, where are you going?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ði ˈizi ˈkwɛsʧənz wɛr ɑr ju ˈɡoʊɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 現在問簡單的問題，你要去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Toronto, the big city in Canada.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈrɑntoʊ ðə bɪɡ ˈsɪti ɪn ˈkænədə./
dialogue.zh: 多倫多，加拿大的大城市。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For work or for visiting someone?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr wɜrk ɔr fɔr ˈvɪzɪtɪŋ ˈsʌmˌwʌn./
dialogue.zh: 是要工作，還是要看人？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Visiting, my friend lives there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɪzɪtɪŋ maɪ frɛnd lɪvz ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 探訪朋友，他住在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who is he, how long have you known him?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz hi haʊ lɔŋ hæv ju noʊn hɪm./
dialogue.zh: 他是誰，你認識他多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peter, we met in school, ten years ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpitər wi mɛt ɪn skul tɛn jɪrz əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 彼得，我們上學時認識，十年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A long friendship, does he live alone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɔŋ ˈfrɛndʃɪp dʌz hi lɪv əˈloʊn./
dialogue.zh: 長長的交情，他是一個人住嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, with his aunt and two cousins.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wɪð hɪz ænt ænd tu ˈkʌzənz./
dialogue.zh: 不是，他和阿姨還有兩個表哥住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you will stay at their home.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju wɪl steɪ æt ðɛr hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 所以你會住在他們家裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, his room is free for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hɪz rum ɪz fri fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 對，他的房間是空下來給我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That saves on the hotel bill, good planning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt seɪvz ɑn ðə hoʊˈtɛl bɪl ɡʊd ˈplænɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這樣省下住宿費，規劃得不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wallet says thank you to Peter.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈwɑlɪt sɛz θæŋk ju tu ˈpitər./
dialogue.zh: 我的錢包要好好謝謝彼得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does his address match the invitation letter?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hɪz əˈdrɛs mætʃ ði ˌɪnvəˈteɪʃən ˈlɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 他的地址跟邀請函上的一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It should, I copied line by line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃʊd aɪ ˈkɑpid laɪn baɪ laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 應該一樣，我一行一行抄的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same street, same number, that is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm strit seɪm ˈnʌmbər ðæt ɪz raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 同一條街、同一個門牌，對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two copies, so you have one too.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈkɑpiz soʊ ju hæv wʌn tu./
dialogue.zh: 我帶了兩份，所以你有一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The other stays in your folder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈʌðər steɪz ɪn jɔr ˈfoʊldər./
dialogue.zh: 另一張留在你的文件夾裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do you need my flight ticket?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ du ju nid maɪ flaɪt ˈtɪkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 為什麼要我的機票？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We check that you have a way home.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tʃɛk ðæt ju hæv ə weɪ hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 我們要確認你有回來的路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back on October seventeen, same airport.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɑn ɑkˈtoʊbər ˌsɛvənˈtin seɪm ˈɛrˌpɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 10 月 17 日回來，同一個機場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve days, and the leaves will be yellow.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv deɪz ænd ðə livz wɪl bi ˈjɛloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 十二天，那陣子樹葉會變黃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have never been to Canada.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ˈnɛvər bɪn tu ˈkænədə./
dialogue.zh: 我從沒去過加拿大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any other trips abroad, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈʌðər trɪps əˈbrɔd ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那你有去過其他國家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two trips to Japan, years ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu trɪps tu dʒəˈpæn jɪrz əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 去過日本兩次，好幾年前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you stay inside the dates each time?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju steɪ ɪnˈsaɪd ðə deɪts iʧ taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 每一次都有留在規定的天數內嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both times, one day early even.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ taɪmz wʌn deɪ ˈɜrli ˈivən./
dialogue.zh: 兩次都提早一天回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good history, that helps your file.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈhɪstəri ðæt hɛlps jɔr faɪl./
dialogue.zh: 紀錄很好，這對你的檔案有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old passports are at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ oʊld ˈpæspɔrtz ɑr æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 舊護照都放在家裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring them if we ask, not today.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðɛm ɪf wi æsk nɑt təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 如果我們要求再補，今天不用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You will ask about my job now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl æsk əˈbaʊt maɪ dʒɑb naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你接下來要問我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, and what exactly is your job?
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈrɛkt ænd wʌt ɪɡˈzæktli ɪz jɔr ʤɑb./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，那你的工作確切是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I fix computers at a small school.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fɪks kəmˈpjutərz æt ə smɔl skul./
dialogue.zh: 我在一所小學校負責電腦維護。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many years with the same school?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni jɪrz wɪð ðə seɪm skul./
dialogue.zh: 在同一個學校待幾年了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six years, since my first salary.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks jɪrz sɪns maɪ fɜrst ˈsæləri./
dialogue.zh: 六年了，從第一份薪水開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steady, that is what we like to see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɛdi ðæt ɪz wɑt wi laɪk tu si./
dialogue.zh: 很穩定，我們就喜歡這種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The job letter is in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɑb ˈlɛtər ɪz ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl./
dialogue.zh: 在職證明放在文件夾中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I see the red seal, very nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ si ðə rɛd sil ˈvɛri naɪs./
dialogue.zh: 看到了，紅色的章，很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next you ask who pays for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst ju æsk hu peɪz fɔr ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 下一個問題是誰出錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, who is paying for your ticket?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hu ɪz ˈpeɪɪŋ fɔr jɔr ˈtɪkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，你的機票是誰付的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Me, from my own bank account.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi frʌm maɪ oʊn bæŋk əˈkaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 我自己，用我自己的銀行帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The records show six calm months.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈrɛkərdz ʃoʊ sɪks kɑm mʌnθs./
dialogue.zh: 紀錄顯示六個月都很平穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No big loans, I promise that.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bɪɡ loʊnz aɪ ˈprɑmɪs ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 沒有大筆借款，這點我可以保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, money from a friend looks strange.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmʌni frʌm ə frɛnd lʊks streɪndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 很好，朋友突然給錢會很可疑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peter pays for dinner, not my airfare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpitər peɪz fɔr ˈdɪnər nɑt maɪ ˈɛrˌfɛr./
dialogue.zh: 彼得請我吃飯，但不幫我付機票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That answer is honest, I like it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈænsər ɪz ˈɑnɪst aɪ laɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這答案很誠實，我喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to say more today?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu seɪ mɔr təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天我還要補充什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have family living in Canada?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈfæməli ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn ˈkænədə./
dialogue.zh: 你在加拿大有家人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife stays here, she has work.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf steɪz hɪr ʃi hæz wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 我太太留在這裡，她有工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any children, or only a cat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈtʃɪldrən ɔr ˈoʊnli ə kæt./
dialogue.zh: 有小孩嗎，還是只有貓？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No children, just a cat named Miso.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈtʃɪldrən dʒʌst ə kæt neɪmd ˈmisoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 沒有小孩，只有一隻貓叫味噌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A cat is a good reason to come back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kæt ɪz ə ɡʊd ˈrizən tu kʌm bæk./
dialogue.zh: 有一隻貓也是回來的好理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She waits by the door, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi weɪts baɪ ðə dɔr ˈɑnəstli./
dialogue.zh: 說真的，她每天都在門口等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the officer abroad will smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ði ˈɔfəsər əˈbrɔd wɪl smaɪl./
dialogue.zh: 那國外審核的人看到也會笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my folder complete now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ ˈfoʊldər kəmˈplit naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我的文件現在齊全了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, one page stops me here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst wʌn peɪdʒ stɑps mi hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，有一頁把我卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The job letter with the red seal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɑb ˈlɛtər wɪð ðə rɛd sil./
dialogue.zh: 是那張蓋紅章的在職證明嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this page is not in English.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɪs peɪdʒ ɪz nɑt ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ./
dialogue.zh: 對，這一頁不是英文。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the heading says our school name.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə ˈhɛdɪŋ sɛz aʊr skul neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 但上面那一行是學校的英文名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A heading alone tells us nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhɛdɪŋ əˈloʊn tɛlz ʌz ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 只有標題的話，我們什麼也看不出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I must add a translation?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ mʌst æd ə ˌtrænsˈleɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 所以我得補一份翻譯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole page, in English, signed and sealed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl peɪʤ ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ saɪnd ænd sild./
dialogue.zh: 整頁都要英文，還要蓋章簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get that inside this building?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ðæt ɪnˈsaɪd ðɪs ˈbɪldɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這棟樓裡面就能翻譯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second floor, the desk beside the stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd flɔr ðə dɛsk bəˈsaɪd ðə stɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 二樓，樓梯旁那張桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they work until five?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ wɜrk ʌnˈtɪl faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 他們開到五點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Until six, and they are fast today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈtɪl sɪks ænd ðeɪ ɑr fæst təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 開到六點，他們今天很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for one small page?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ fɔr wʌn smɔl peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 一張小小的要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About thirty dollars, they told me.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˈθɜrdi ˈdɑlərz ðeɪ toʊld mi./
dialogue.zh: 大約 30 美元，他們是這樣說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty! I only have ten in cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrdi aɪ ˈoʊnli hæv tɛn ɪn kæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 三十美元！我現金只剩下十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They take cards there, that machine is fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ teɪk kɑrdz ðɛr ðæt məˈʃin ɪz fæst./
dialogue.zh: 那邊收卡，那台機器還很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky, the card machine here failed first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ðə kɑrd məˈʃin hɪr feɪld fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 巧了，這裡的刷卡機早上才壞過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back to me, the chair is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm bæk tu mi ðə tʃɛr ɪz jʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 回來找我，這個位置還是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will run, it is only one floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl rʌn ɪt ɪz ˈoʊnli wʌn flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我快去快回，只差一層樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not lose your place at window nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt luz jɔr pleɪs æt ˈwɪndoʊ naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 別把九號窗口的位子丟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Second floor, is this the translation desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd flɔr ɪz ðɪs ðə trænˈsleɪʃən dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 二樓，這裡是翻譯的桌子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take a seat, two people ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs teɪk ə sit tu ˈpipəl əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 對，先坐，你前面還有兩位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will wait, my legs are fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl weɪt maɪ lɛɡz ɑr faɪn./
