dialogue.zh: 我願意等，我的腿還撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the folder with you, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə ˈfoʊldər wɪð ju pliz./
dialogue.zh: 文件夾也一起帶到座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One lady, one student, both with papers.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈleɪdi wʌn ˈstudənt boʊθ wɪð ˈpeɪpərz./
dialogue.zh: 一位女士、一個學生，手上都是文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The student needs a school paper today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈstudənt nidz ə skul ˈpeɪpər təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那個學生今天急著翻學業證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same problem as mine, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈprɑbləm æz maɪn ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那跟我的狀況一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very common here, Chinese in, English out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri ˈkɑmən hɪr ˌtʃaɪˈniz ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡很常見，中文進去、英文出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The line moved, it is my turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪn muvd ɪt ɪz maɪ tɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 隊伍往前了，輪到我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hello, what paper do you have there?
dialogue.phonetic: /həˈloʊ wɑt ˈpeɪpər du ju hæv ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 你好，你手上拿的是哪張文件？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A job letter from my small school.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dʒɑb ˈlɛtər frʌm maɪ smɔl skul./
dialogue.zh: 我們小學校開的在職證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I need the original and one copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ði əˈrɪdʒɪnəl ænd wʌn ˈkɑpi./
dialogue.zh: 正本和一份影本我都要看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both are here, with one spare copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ɑr hɪr wɪð wʌn sɛr ˈkɑpi./
dialogue.zh: 兩張都在，還多帶一份備用影本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I keep two and return one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ kip tu ænd rɪˈtɜrn wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那我留兩張，還你一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does one page take?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz wʌn peɪdʒ teɪk./
dialogue.zh: 一頁大約要翻多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, I type while I read.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts aɪ taɪp waɪl aɪ rid./
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，我邊看邊打字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty, my window is waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti maɪ ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘啊，九號窗口還在等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit there, I will call your name.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ðɛr aɪ wɪl kɔl jɔr neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 坐那邊，我會叫你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mister Lin, the short blue shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪstər lɪn ðə ʃɔrt blu ʃɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 林先生，穿藍色短袖的那位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sir, please watch the small screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs sɜr pliz wɑtʃ ðə smɔl skrin./
dialogue.zh: 對，先生，請注意那塊小螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I pay, and how?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt du aɪ peɪ ænd haʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我要付多少，怎麼付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty dollars, your card is fine here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrdi ˈdɑlərz jɔr kɑrd ɪz faɪn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 30 美元，這邊刷卡就可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The machine here does work!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin hɪr dʌz wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的機器會動耶！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are not the bank, thank goodness.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr nɑt ðə bæŋk θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs./
dialogue.zh: 我們不是銀行，謝天謝地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, my job title.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ maɪ dʒɑb ˈtaɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，我的職位名稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How is it written in English, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ɪz ɪt ˈrɪtən ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪɡˈzæktli./
dialogue.zh: 英文準確起來要怎麼寫？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Helper at the computer desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛlpər æt ðə kəmˈpjutər dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 電腦桌的協助人員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write assistant, it sounds clearer.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl raɪt əˈsɪstənt ɪt saʊndz ˈklɪrər./
dialogue.zh: 我翻成助理，那個說法更清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Assistant, yes, that is me.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈsɪstənt jɛs ðæt ɪz mi./
dialogue.zh: 對，助理就是我這個職稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the page, twenty minutes flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə peɪʤ ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts flæt./
dialogue.zh: 這一頁翻好了，整整二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already? Let me read your typing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi lɛt mi rid jɔr ˈtaɪpɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這麼快？讓我讀一下你打的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next to my stamp, please sign the page.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst tu maɪ stæmp pliz saɪn ðə peɪʤ./
dialogue.zh: 請在我的章旁邊把這一頁簽好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, I signed right by your stamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr aɪ saɪnd raɪt baɪ jɔr stæmp./
dialogue.zh: 好了，我剛好簽在你的章旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stamped and signed, the office will accept it.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæmpt ænd saɪnd ði ˈɔfəs wɪl əkˈsɛpt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 有章又有簽名，那邊一定會收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I run back to window nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ rʌn bæk tu ˈwɪndoʊ naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那我趕快跑回九號窗口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the elevator, the stairs are slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ði ˈɛləˌveɪtər ðə stɛrz ɑr sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 搭電梯吧，走樓梯太慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The doors are open, lucky me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔrz ɑr ˈoʊpən ˈlʌki mi./
dialogue.zh: 電梯門正好開著，我真幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smile, you are just in time.
dialogue.phonetic: /smaɪl ju ɑr dʒʌst ɪn taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 笑一下，你剛剛好趕上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Window nine, here is one more page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪndoʊ naɪn hɪr ɪz wʌn mɔr peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 九號窗口，我多了一頁回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stamped and signed, perfect, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæmpt ænd saɪnd ˈpɜrfɪkt θæŋk ju./
dialogue.zh: 有章有簽名，太好了，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my folder is whole now?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ ˈfoʊldər ɪz hoʊl naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那我的文件現在齊全了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whole, and we can finish the talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊl ænd wi kæn ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 齊了，我們可以把問題問完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More questions, I hoped not.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr ˈkwɛsʧənz aɪ hoʊpt nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 還有問題啊，我希望不要太多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two only, then the passport part.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈoʊnli ðɛn ðə ˈpæspɔrt pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 只剩兩個，然後是護照那段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask me, my mind is clear now.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk mi maɪ maɪnd ɪz klɪr naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你問吧，我現在思緒很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many days will you stay, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni deɪz wɪl ju steɪ ɪɡˈzæktli./
dialogue.zh: 你一共要待幾天？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve days, I counted on paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv deɪz aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd ɑn ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 十二天，我在紙上數過一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leaving October five, back on the seventeen?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlivɪŋ ɑkˈtoʊbər faɪv bæk ɑn ði ˌsɛvənˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 10 月 5 日出發，17 日回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the same two dates on my form.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə seɪm tu deɪts ɑn maɪ fɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 對，表格上也是這兩組日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, dates must match across papers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd deɪts mʌst mætʃ əˈkrɔs ˈpeɪpərz./
dialogue.zh: 很好，每張紙的日期都要一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I checked them three times last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʃɛkt ðɛm θri taɪmz læst naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我昨晚從頭核對三次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is rare, most people miss a date.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz rɛr moʊst ˈpipəl mɪs ə deɪt./
dialogue.zh: 很少人這樣，多數人都會漏一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next, what I do there, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst wʌt aɪ du ðɛr raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 再來要問我在那邊做什麼，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tell me about your twelve days.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tɛl mi əˈbaʊt jɔr twɛlv deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 對，說說你這十二天要怎麼過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three days resting, I am tired already.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri deɪz ˈrɛstɪŋ aɪ æm ˈtaɪərd ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 前三天先倒時差休息，我已經累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest days are fine, no paper needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst deɪz ɑr faɪn noʊ ˈpeɪpər ˈnidɪd./
dialogue.zh: 休息日沒關係，不用附證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then one hockey game, Saturday night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wʌn ˈhɑki ɡeɪm ˈsætərˌdeɪ naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 然後是一場冰球賽，週六晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: October ten, the arena is near the lake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑkˈtoʊbər tɛn ði əˈrinə ɪz nɪr ðə leɪk./
dialogue.zh: 10 月 10 日，那個場館就在湖邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peter has two seats, he bought them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpitər hæz tu sits hi bɔt ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 彼得買了兩個座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, keep the ticket stub in your bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs kip ðə ˈtɪkɪt stʌb ɪn jɔr bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 很好，票根放進包包留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A museum on Monday, one on Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə mjuˈziəm ɑn ˈmʌnˌdeɪ wʌn ɑn ˈfraɪˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 星期一去一個博物館，星期五再去一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On different days, that is a real plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ˈdɪfərənt deɪz ðæt ɪz ə ril plæn./
dialogue.zh: 拆開兩天去，這才是真的排行程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One day at the falls, by bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn deɪ æt ðə fɔlz baɪ bʌs./
dialogue.zh: 有一天去瀑布，搭巴士。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A long day, ten hours there and back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɔŋ deɪ tɛn ˈaʊrz ðɛr ænd bæk./
dialogue.zh: 那是趟長途，來回十個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By bus, I do not drive in cities.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ bʌs aɪ du nɑt draɪv ɪn ˈsɪtɪz./
dialogue.zh: 坐巴士，我在大城市不想開車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, the snow will come in November.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ðə snoʊ wɪl kʌm ɪn noʊˈvɛmbər./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，十一月就要下雪了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My last day is for the market.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ læst deɪ ɪz fɔr ðə ˈmɑrkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 最後那一天我排給市集。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The old market has good soup, try it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði oʊld ˈmɑrkɪt hæz ɡʊd sup traɪ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 老城區那個市集的湯很好喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot cook, so soup is perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkænɑt kʊk soʊ sup ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt./
dialogue.zh: 我煮飯不行，所以湯剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peter will cook, I am sure of that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpitər wɪl kʊk aɪ æm ʃʊr ʌv ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 彼得會煮，這點我很確定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He makes noodles, badly, but he tries.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi meɪks ˈnudəlz ˈbædli bʌt hi traɪz./
dialogue.zh: 他煮的麵很難吃，但他願意試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve days of noodles, brave man.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv deɪz ʌv ˈnudəlz breɪv mæn./
dialogue.zh: 十二天都吃麵，他真有勇氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also I must send two postcards.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ aɪ mʌst sɛnd tu ˈpoʊstˌkɑrdz./
dialogue.zh: 還有，我一定要寄兩張明信片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For your wife, or only for yourself?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr jɔr waɪf ɔr ˈoʊnli fɔr jɔrˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 給你太太的，還是只給自己？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One for my wife, one for my mother.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fɔr maɪ waɪf wʌn fɔr maɪ ˈmʌðər./
dialogue.zh: 一張給我太太，一張給我媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, families like a card, not a call.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈfæməlɪz laɪk ə kɑrd nɑt ə kɔl./
dialogue.zh: 真好，家人喜歡明信片勝過電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She will want a photo of the tower.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl wɑnt ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ʌv ðə ˈtaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 她會想要一張那棟高塔的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tower near the lake, very high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtaʊər nɪr ðə leɪk ˈvɛri haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 湖邊那棟塔，非常高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to buy that ticket now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu baɪ ðæt ˈtɪkɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那張門票我要先買好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, tickets are cheap at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈtɪkɪts ɑr tʃip æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 不用，現場買也不貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife has not packed a single thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf hæz nɑt pækt ə ˈsɪŋɡəl θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我太太還沒有收拾任何東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You have eight weeks, that is plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæv eɪt wikz ðæt ɪz ˈplɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 你還有八週，很夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She packs, I only carry the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi pæks aɪ ˈoʊnli ˈkæri ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 她負責收拾，我只負責提。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair work, some men fold very badly.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr wɜrk sʌm mɛn foʊld ˈvɛri ˈbædli./
dialogue.zh: 分工公道的，有些男人折衣服很糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I fold socks, that is all my skill.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ foʊld sɑks ðæt ɪz ɔl maɪ skɪl./
dialogue.zh: 我只會折襪子，那就是我的全部功力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Socks at the bottom, that is correct.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɑks æt ðə ˈbɑtəm ðæt ɪz kəˈrɛkt./
dialogue.zh: 襪子放最底層，那就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Insurance is in there, twelve days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈʃʊrəns ɪz ɪn ðɛr twɛlv deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 保險就在裡面，也是十二天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I see it, dated from the fifth.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ si ɪt ˈdeɪtɪd frʌm ðə fɪfθ./
dialogue.zh: 看到了，生效日也是五號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything else missing from me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls ˈmɪsɪŋ frʌm mi./
dialogue.zh: 我還有少帶什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, your file is ready for review.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ jɔr faɪl ɪz ˈrɛdi fɔr ˌrivˈju./
dialogue.zh: 沒了，你的檔案可以送審了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Review by whom, the office abroad?
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈvju baɪ hum ði ˈɔfɪs əˈbrɔd./
dialogue.zh: 由誰審，國外那間辦公室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, an officer there reads every page.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ən ˈɔfəsər ðɛr ridz ˈɛvri peɪʤ./
dialogue.zh: 對，那邊會有一位簽證官看過每一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The standard eight working days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈstændərd eɪt ˈwɜrkɪŋ deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 標準的八個工作天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so the answer comes by August twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs soʊ ði ˈænsər kʌmz baɪ ˈɔɡəst ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 對，所以 8 月 20 號前會有回覆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: August twenty, a Thursday, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔɡəst ˈtwɛnti ə ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 8 月 20 號，是星期四，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I checked the calendar for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ tʃɛkt ðə ˈkæləndər fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 對，我幫你看過行事曆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is kind, I write it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz kaɪnd aɪ raɪt ɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 你好細心，我把它抄下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now counter six, they keep the passport.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ˈkaʊntər sɪks ðeɪ kip ðə ˈpæspɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 現在去六號櫃台，那邊收護照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counter six, I go right away?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntər sɪks aɪ ɡoʊ raɪt əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 六號櫃台，我現在就走過去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right away, the line there is short.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt əˈweɪ ðə laɪn ðɛr ɪz ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 馬上過去，那邊的隊伍很短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counter six, here is my passport.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntər sɪks hɪr ɪz maɪ ˈpæspɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 六號櫃台，我的護照在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, did window nine send you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd dɪd ˈwɪndoʊ naɪn sɛnd ju./
dialogue.zh: 好，是九號窗口請你過來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, she said you keep it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃi sɛd ju kip ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，她說你們會收護照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hold it while they print the sticker.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hoʊld ɪt waɪl ðeɪ prɪnt ðə ˈstɪkər./
dialogue.zh: 他們貼紙的時候，護照在我們這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A sticker, so the visa goes inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈstɪkər soʊ ðə ˈvizə ɡoʊz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 一張貼紙，所以簽證會貼在裡面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small page, near the front of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl peɪdʒ nɪr ðə frʌnt ʌv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 就貼在前面一點的空白頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My two empty pages, that is why.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tu ˈɛmpli ˈpeɪdʒəz ðæt ɪz waɪ./
dialogue.zh: 所以那兩張空白頁這麼要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, no space means no sticker.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli noʊ speɪs minz noʊ ˈstɪkər./
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，沒有空白頁就貼不下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before it leaves my hand, one favor.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ɪt livz maɪ hænd wʌn ˈfeɪvər./
dialogue.zh: 它離開我手之前，請幫個忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, tell me what you need.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr tɛl mi wʌt ju nid./
dialogue.zh: 好啊，你說說要什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I keep a copy of the photo page?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ kip ə ˈkɑpi ʌv ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ peɪʤ./
dialogue.zh: 我可以留一張照片頁的影本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I scan it now, hold still.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ skæn ɪt naʊ hoʊld stɪl./
dialogue.zh: 可以，我現在掃，手別動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was fast, my wife will relax.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz fæst maɪ waɪf wɪl rɪˈlæks./
dialogue.zh: 好快，我太太可以放心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A copy in a drawer is wise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkɑpi ɪn ə drɔr ɪz waɪz./
dialogue.zh: 抽屜裡放一張影本是聰明的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, how do I get the book back?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ haʊ du aɪ ɡɛt ðə bʊk bæk./
dialogue.zh: 那麼，我怎麼把護照拿回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two ways: come here, or use a courier.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu weɪz kʌm hɪr ɔr juz ə ˈkʊriər./
dialogue.zh: 兩種：自己來領，或是用快遞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the courier, what is the cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈkʊriər wʌt ɪz ðə kɔst./
dialogue.zh: 那用快遞的話，要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-five dollars, and it comes to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti faɪv ˈdɑlərz ænd ɪt kʌmz tu ju./
dialogue.zh: 25 美元，它會直接送到你家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And coming here myself is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈkʌmɪŋ hɪr maɪˈsɛlf ɪz fri./
dialogue.zh: 自己過來領則是免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free, but only after three on weekdays.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri bʌt ˈoʊnli ˈæftər θri ɑn ˈwikˌdeɪz./
dialogue.zh: 免費，不過平日三點以後才領得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After three, my afternoons are full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər θri maɪ ˌæftərˈnunz ɑr fʊl./
dialogue.zh: 三點以後，我下午都是滿的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the courier will be your friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈkʊriər wɪl bi jɔr frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 那快遞會變成你的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is cheap for a friend like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz tʃip fɔr ə frɛnd laɪk ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 這種朋友算便宜的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-five buys you two hundred steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti faɪv baɪz ju tu ˈhʌndrəd stɛps./
dialogue.zh: 25 美元幫你少走兩百步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hundred steps, I counted my walk today.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈhʌndrəd stɛps aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd maɪ wɔk təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 兩百步啊，我今天數過自己走了多少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people walk more than they think here.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl wɔk mɔr ðæn ðeɪ θɪŋk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，多數人走的比想得還多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I already climbed two floors this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi klaɪmd tu flɔrz ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 今天早上我已經爬過兩層樓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No more stairs for you today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɔr stɛrz fɔr ju təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天就別再爬樓梯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, so I will pick the courier.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd soʊ aɪ wɪl pɪk ðə ˈkʊriər./
dialogue.zh: 好，那我就選快遞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, this blue card, fill all the lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ðɪs blu kɑrd fɪl ɔl ðə laɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 請填這張藍色小卡，每一欄都寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Name, phone, street, floor, and code.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm foʊn strit flɔr ænd koʊd./
dialogue.zh: 姓名、電話、地址、樓層、郵遞區號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The code needs five numbers, look closely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə koʊd nidz faɪv ˈnʌmbərz lʊk ˈkloʊsli./
dialogue.zh: 郵遞區號要五個數字，看仔細。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine has only four, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn hæz ˈoʊnli fɔr aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我寫的只有四個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are right, one number is missing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr raɪt wʌn ˈnʌmbər ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 你沒看錯，少了一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife wrote that list for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf roʊt ðæt lɪst fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 那是內人幫我抄的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Message her now, I will wait here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛsɪdʒ hɜr naʊ aɪ wɪl weɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 現在發訊息問她，我在這裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She answers in one minute, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈænsərz ɪn wʌn ˈmɪnɪt ˈɔlˌweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 她一定一分鐘就回，總是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask for the code alone, not the street.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk fɔr ðə koʊd əˈloʊn nɑt ðə strit./
dialogue.zh: 只要問區號，地址不要重問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, her message, five clean numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr hɜr ˈmɛsɪdʒ faɪv klin ˈnʌmbərz./
dialogue.zh: 來了，她傳了五個清楚的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I type them on the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ taɪp ðɛm ɑn ðə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 很好，我把它們打在這張卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You fixed it while I just sat here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju fɪkst ɪt waɪl aɪ ʤʌst sæt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我只是坐在那裡，你就把號碼補好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Missing codes are our top problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪsɪŋ koʊdz ɑr aʊr tɑp ˈprɑbləm./
dialogue.zh: 缺號碼是我們最常遇到的狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else goes wrong with couriers?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɛls ɡoʊz rɔŋ wɪð ˈkʊriərz./
dialogue.zh: 快遞還會出什麼問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A phone number that nobody answers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə foʊn ˈnʌmbər ðæt ˈnoʊˌbɑdi ˈænsərz./
dialogue.zh: 電話號碼打了沒人接。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine gets answered all day, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɡɛts ˈænsərd ɔl deɪ aɪ ˈprɑmɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我的電話整天都有人接，這點保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then write it big, like a school sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn raɪt ɪt bɪɡ laɪk ə skul saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那就寫大一點，像學校的牌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big numbers, my handwriting is small.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ ˈnʌmbərz maɪ ˈhændˌraɪtɪŋ ɪz smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 寫大的數字，我的字一向很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will print the card with big letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl prɪnt ðə kɑrd wɪð bɪɡ ˈlɛtərz./
dialogue.zh: 我會把這張卡印出來，字用大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Print it, please, my eyes are tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɪnt ɪt pliz maɪ aɪz ɑr ˈtaɪərd./
dialogue.zh: 列印吧，拜託，我的眼睛累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, now sign the last two lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn naʊ saɪn ðə læst tu laɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 好了，現在最後兩行簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two lines, why not just one?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu laɪnz waɪ nɑt dʒʌst wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 兩行，為什麼不簽一個就好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One for us, one for the courier company.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fɔr ʌs wʌn fɔr ðə ˈkʊriər ˈkʌmpəni./
dialogue.zh: 一行給我們，一行給快遞公司。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same name, same letters, same pen.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm neɪm seɪm ˈlɛtərz seɪm pɛn./
dialogue.zh: 同樣的名字、同樣的字、同樣的筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the black one, not the blue you hold.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə blæk wʌn nɑt ðə blu ju hoʊld./
dialogue.zh: 對，用黑色那支，不是你手上的藍色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old habits, my hand forgot.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈhæbəts maɪ hænd fərˈɡɑt./
dialogue.zh: 舊習慣害的，我的手忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, both lines read the same now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr boʊθ laɪnz rid ðə seɪm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好了，兩行簽得一模一樣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who signs when the box arrives?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu saɪnz wɛn ðə bɑks əˈraɪvz./
dialogue.zh: 包裹到的時候誰要簽名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any adult at your door, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈædʌlt æt jɔr dɔr ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 你家門口任何一個大人就可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My building has a lobby man.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbɪldɪŋ hæz ə ˈlɑbi mæn./
dialogue.zh: 我們大樓有管理員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then he can take it for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hi kæn teɪk ɪt fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 那他可以幫代收，你不用擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is old and very careful.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz oʊld ænd ˈvɛri ˈkɛrfəl./
dialogue.zh: 他上了年紀，而且非常小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful men guard passports well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl mɛn ɡɑrd ˈpæspɔrtz wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 小心的人才守得住護照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if nobody signs that day?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪf ˈnoʊˌbɑdi saɪnz ðæt deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 如果那天沒有人在簽收呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He leaves a card and comes again.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi livz ə kɑrd ænd kʌmz əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 他留一張通知單，明天再來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Again the next day, no extra money?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɛn ðə nɛkst deɪ noʊ ˈɛkstrə ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 隔天再送一次，不用再加錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more try is free, the third is not.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr traɪ ɪz fri ðə θɜrd ɪz nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 再送一次免費，第三次就要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will be home, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl bi hoʊm θæŋk ju./
dialogue.zh: 那我那天一定在家，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And if he fails twice, you visit us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf hi feɪlz twaɪs ju ˈvɪzɪt ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 如果兩次都送不到，你就來我們這裡領。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here again, after three?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr əˈɡɛn ˈæftər θri./
dialogue.zh: 又是這裡，三點以後嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same rule, bring this card and your ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm rul brɪŋ ðɪs kɑrd ænd jɔr ˌaɪˈdi./
dialogue.zh: 同樣的規則，帶著這張卡和身分證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the little box safe on the road?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈlɪtəl bɑks seɪf ɑn ðə roʊd./
dialogue.zh: 那個小盒子在路上安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is sealed, and your number is on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz sild ænd jɔr ˈnʌmbər ɪz ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 它會封好，上面有你的號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sealed, so I cannot open it early?
dialogue.phonetic: /sild soʊ aɪ ˈkænɑt ˈoʊpən ɪt ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 封起來，所以我不能提前打開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it only when your name is checked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt ˈoʊnli wɛn jɔr neɪm ɪz tʃɛkt./
dialogue.zh: 簽收核對名字之後才能拆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Checked by the courier, at the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛkt baɪ ðə ˈkʊriər æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 快遞人員在門口核對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He reads the card, then hands you the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ridz ðə kɑrd ðɛn hændz ju ðə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 他看單子，然後把盒子交給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Losing it would be the worst day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈluzɪŋ ɪt wʊd bi ðə wɜrst deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 要是弄丟了，那是我人生最糟的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If we lose it, we pay the new fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf wi luz ɪt wi peɪ ðə nu fi./
dialogue.zh: 如果是我們弄丟，補發的規費我們出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You pay the government fee too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju peɪ ðə ˈɡʌvərmənt fi tu./
dialogue.zh: 政府那邊的規費你們也付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and we hand you a paper note.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd wi hænd ju ə ˈpeɪpər noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 對，而且會給你一張書面的證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A note, so I still need the passport number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə noʊt soʊ aɪ stɪl nid ðə ˈpæspɔrt ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 那張單子，所以我還是得記住護照號碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your copy page has it, in the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈkɑpi peɪdʒ hæz ɪt ɪn ðə drɔr./
dialogue.zh: 你影本那一頁就有，在抽屜裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am glad I made that copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ɡlæd aɪ meɪd ðət ˈkɑpi./
dialogue.zh: 幸好我今天影了一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the courier money, card or cash?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈkʊriər ˈmʌni kɑrd ɔr kæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 現在付快遞的錢，刷卡還是現金？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, my ten dollars stay in my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd maɪ tɛn ˈdɑlərz steɪ ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 刷卡，那 10 美元現金我留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, my machine is awake today.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr maɪ məˈʃin ɪz əˈweɪk təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 應該的，我這台機器今天是醒著的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awake, the one at counter three was not.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈweɪk ðə wʌn æt ˈkaʊntər θri wʌz nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 醒著就好，三號櫃台那台早上是死的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It woke at eleven, the news came down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt woʊk æt ɪˈlɛvən ðə nuz keɪm daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 它十一點通了，消息剛傳下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my card has paid two places now.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ kɑrd hæz peɪd tu ˈpleɪsəz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 所以我的卡今天付了兩個地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, but the big fee was cash, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bʌt ðə bɪɡ fi wʌz kæʃ raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 兩處，不過大規費付的是現金，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, cash for the visa, card for the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt kæʃ fɔr ðə ˈvizə kɑrd fɔr ðə rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 對，簽證費付現金，其他的刷卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, twenty-five dollars, all settled.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ˈtwɛnti faɪv ˈdɑlərz ɔl ˈsɛtəld./
dialogue.zh: 好了，25 美元，這一筆結清了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty-five, done, no receipt needed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti faɪv dʌn noʊ riˈsit ˈnidɪd./
dialogue.zh: 25 美元，好了，不用收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You get one slip for everything today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɛt wʌn slɪp fɔr ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天所有的事，會合成一張單子給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will I know the box leaves you?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ wɪl aɪ noʊ ðə bɑks livz ju./
dialogue.zh: 我要怎麼知道包裹從你們那邊出發？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One short text arrives the night before.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ʃɔrt tɛkst əˈraɪvz ðə naɪt bɪˈfɔr./
dialogue.zh: 前一晚會來一則短短的簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that text show my number, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðæt tɛkst ʃoʊ maɪ ˈnʌmbər tu./
dialogue.zh: 那則簡訊會印我的編號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It ends in oh seven, look for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɛndz ɪn oʊ ˈsɛvən lʊk fɔr ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 最後兩位是零七，看到那個就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One blue paper for all of this?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn blu ˈpeɪpər ɔr ɔl ʌv ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 一張藍色的紙，涵蓋今天所有的事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sign the last line, walk to the end desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪn ðə læst laɪn wɔk tu ði ɛnd dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 簽最後一行，走到最尾那張桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The end desk, hello, for my blue slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛnd dɛsk həˈloʊ fɔr maɪ blu slɪp./
dialogue.zh: 最尾那張桌子，你好，我來領藍色單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mister Lin, here, one page for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪstər lɪn hɪr wʌn peɪdʒ fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 林先生，在這裡，這一頁是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says four four oh seven again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz fɔr fɔr oʊ ˈsɛvən əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 上面又寫了 4407。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your receipt number is your file number.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr riˈsit ˈnʌmbər ɪz jɔr faɪl ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 你的收據號同時就是你的檔案號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One number for everything, simple.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈnʌmbər fɔr ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ˈsɪmpəl./
dialogue.zh: 一個號碼管所有事，真簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on your hand if you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt ɑn jɔr hænd ɪf ju laɪk./
dialogue.zh: 你需要的話，寫在手背上也行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And here, August twenty, in bold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd hɪr ˈɔɡəst ˈtwɛnti ɪn boʊld./
dialogue.zh: 還有這裡，8 月 20 號，粗體字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the last day we promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə læst deɪ wi ˈprɑmɪs./
dialogue.zh: 那一天是我們承諾的最後期限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The last day, so maybe sooner?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst deɪ soʊ ˈmeɪbi ˈsunər./
dialogue.zh: 最後期限，那也許會更早？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Often sooner, very rarely later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔfən ˈsunər ˈvɛri ˈrɛrli ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 常常比較早，很少有晚的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the courier comes August twenty-one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈkʊriər kʌmz ˈɔɡəst ˈtwɛnti wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那快遞就是 8 月 21 號送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday, before six, someone must sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ bəˈfɔr sɪks ˈsʌmˌwʌn mʌst saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 星期五，六點以前，要有人簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My lobby man sits there till nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlɑbi mæn sɪts ðɛr tɪl naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我們的管理員坐在那邊待到九點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, he can sign if you are late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd hi kæn saɪn ɪf ju ɑr leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 很好，你遲了他也能代收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mind if I keep this one on my phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪnd ɪf aɪ kip ðɪs wʌn ɑn maɪ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 不介意的話，我想用手機存下這一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a phone keeps paper safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə foʊn kips ˈpeɪpər seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 可以，手機也能幫紙本存一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safe, but I still fold it in my wallet.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf bʌt aɪ stɪl foʊld ɪt ɪn maɪ ˈwɑlɪt./
dialogue.zh: 雖然存了，我還是想把它折進錢包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold it once, not twice, the lines matter.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld ɪt wʌns nɑt twaɪs ðə laɪnz ˈmætər./
dialogue.zh: 折一次就好，折兩次會壓到字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once, done, it fits behind my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns dʌn ɪt fɪts bɪˈhaɪnd maɪ kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 折一次，好了，它剛好在卡片後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then walk out with an empty folder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wɔk aʊt wɪð æn ˈɛmpli ˈfoʊldər./
dialogue.zh: 就帶著空的文件夾走出去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty, my passport is in your drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpli maɪ ˈpæspɔrt ɪz ɪn jɔr drɔr./
dialogue.zh: 空的，我的護照在你們抽屜裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In a locked box, with two hundred others.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ə lɑkt bɑks wɪð tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈʌðərz./
dialogue.zh: 在上鎖的箱子裡，旁邊還有兩百本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hundred, I hope they sleep well.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈhʌndrəd aɪ hoʊp ðeɪ slip wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 兩百本，希望它們都睡得安穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They will return with a sticker each.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl rəˈtɜrn wɪð ə ˈstɪkər iʧ./
dialogue.zh: 它們每一本都會帶著貼紙回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home at last, my wife is at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊm æt læst maɪ waɪf ɪz æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 總算到家了，我太太在門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well? Did you get the little paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl dɪd ju ɡɛt ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 怎麼樣？那張小單子拿到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, one blue slip, four four oh seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk wʌn blu slɪp fɔr fɔr oʊ ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 你看，一張藍色單子，4407。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will hang it on the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl hæŋ ɪt ɑn ðə frɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 那我把它掛在冰箱上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With the magnet from the beach trip?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ðə ˈmæɡnɛt frʌm ðə biʧ trɪp./
dialogue.zh: 用海邊那趟回來的磁鐵嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red one, it holds best of all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd wʌn ɪt hoʊldz bɛst ʌv ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 那顆紅色的，吸得最牢固。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight weeks on that fridge door.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt wikz ɑn ðæt frɪdʒ dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 要在冰箱門上掛八週呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the box comes, and I will count.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə bɑks kʌmz ænd aɪ wɪl kaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 包裹會來，我幫你一天一天數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not count loud, I am nervous.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt kaʊnt laʊd aɪ æm ˈnɜrvəs./
dialogue.zh: 別數太大聲，我會緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will check the spam folder daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tʃɛk ðə spæm ˈfoʊldər ˈdeɪli./
dialogue.zh: 我會每天去看那個雜信夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Daily is enough, once, not ten times.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪli ɪz ɪˈnʌf wʌns nɑt tɛn taɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 一天一次就夠了，不要十次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You refresh the page every hour, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju rɪˈfrɛʃ ðə peɪdʒ ˈɛvri ˈaʊər ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 可是你自己每小時都在重新整理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only while the soup is hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli waɪl ðə sup ɪz hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 只有在等湯熱的時候才看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, then eat your soup, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ðɛn it jɔr sup pliz./
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那你先喝你的湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peter called while I rode the elevator.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpitər kɔld waɪl aɪ roʊd ði ˈɛləˌveɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 彼得在我搭電梯的時候打來過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What did he say about the game?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt dɪd hi seɪ əˈbaʊt ðə ɡeɪm./
dialogue.zh: 他講那場球賽說什麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He kept our two seats, October ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kɛpt aʊr tu sits ɑkˈtoʊbər tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 他幫我們留住那兩個座位，10 月 10 號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you have a reason to be on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju hæv ə ˈrizən tu bi ɑn taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 那你就有理由準時出門了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday nothing, Tuesday quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈtuzˌdeɪ ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 星期一沒消息，星期二很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wednesday, still the blue slip on the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ stɪl ðə blu slɪp ɑn ðə frɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 星期三，藍色單子還貼在冰箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I asked the neighbor, he waited nine months.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æskt ðə ˈneɪbər hi ˈweɪtɪd naɪn mʌnθs./
dialogue.zh: 我問了鄰居，他等了九個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine months, he told me that twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn mʌnθs hi toʊld mi ðæt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 九個月這件事，他講過兩遍了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight working days, that is my luck.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈwɜrkɪŋ deɪz ðæt ɪz maɪ lʌk./
dialogue.zh: 八個工作天，算我運氣好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your luck, or your clean paper list?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr lʌk ɔr jɔr klin ˈpeɪpər lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 是運氣好，還是你的清單寫得乾淨？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday morning, nothing again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈnʌθɪŋ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 星期四早上，依然是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait for the afternoon, they send late.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt fɔr ði ˌæftərˈnun ðeɪ sɛnd leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 等下午吧，他們傳得晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four thirty, a small buzz in my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɔr ˈθɜrdi ə smɔl bʌz ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 四點半，口袋裡震了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it, is it from the center?
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt ɪz ɪt frʌm ðə ˈsɛntər./
dialogue.zh: 唸出來，是從簽證中心傳的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your passport is ready, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈpæspɔrt ɪz ˈrɛdi ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 寫著護照已備好，就只有這一句。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready! Then tomorrow the box comes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi ðɛn təˈmɑroʊ ðə bɑks kʌmz./
dialogue.zh: 備好了！那明天包裹就會到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday, August twenty-one, before six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ˈɔɡəst ˈtwɛnti wʌn bəˈfɔr sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 星期五，8 月 21 號，六點以前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we both stay home, gladly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi boʊθ steɪ hoʊm ˈɡlædli./
dialogue.zh: 那我們兩個都待在家，很願意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I called to check, a lady answered.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kɔld tu tʃɛk ə ˈleɪdi ˈænsərd./
dialogue.zh: 我打去確認，有位小姐接了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What did she say about your number?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt dɪd ʃi seɪ əˈbaʊt jɔr ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 她怎麼說你的那個號碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She found four four oh seven in a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi faʊnd fɔr fɔr oʊ ˈsɛvən ɪn ə ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 她一分鐘就找到了 4407。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fast hands, then your file is whole.
dialogue.phonetic: /fæst hændz ðɛn jɔr faɪl ɪz hoʊl./
dialogue.zh: 手腳真快，那你的檔案齊全了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday at five, a knock at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ æt faɪv ə nɑk æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 星期五五點，有人敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small box, and a lady with a pen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl bɑks ænd ə ˈleɪdi wɪð ə pɛn./
dialogue.zh: 一個小盒子，還有一位拿著筆的小姐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked my name, then the signature.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æskt maɪ neɪm ðɛn ðə ˈsɪɡnətʃər./
dialogue.zh: 她問了我的名字，然後要我簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you write big, like the blue card?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju raɪt bɪɡ laɪk ðə blu kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 你有寫大一點，像那張藍卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big and clear, my best handwriting.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ ænd klɪr maɪ bɛst ˈhændˌraɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 又大又清楚，這是我一輩子最好的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She smiled and gave you the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi smaɪld ænd ɡeɪv ju ðə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 她笑了一下，把盒子交給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tape is sealed, my name is on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə teɪp ɪz sild maɪ neɪm ɪz ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 膠帶封得好好的，上面有我的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it here, on the kitchen table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt hɪr ɑn ðə ˈkɪtʃən ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 就在廚房桌子上打開吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside, the book and one blue paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ðə bʊk ænd wʌn blu ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 裡面是護照，還有一張藍色的紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn to the page near the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn tu ðə peɪdʒ nɪr ðə frʌnt./
dialogue.zh: 翻到靠前面那一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There! A sticker, small and green.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ə ˈstɪkər smɔl ænd ɡrin./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡！一張貼紙，小小綠綠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green is a good color on a Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin ɪz ə ɡʊd ˈkʌlər ɑn ə ˈfraɪˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 星期五看見綠色，是好顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says many entries, read that line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz ˈmɛni ˈɛntriz rid ðæt laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 上面寫多次入境，唸那一行給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many entries, until March twenty twenty-nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ˈɛntrɪz ʌnˈtɪl mɑrʧ ˌtwɛnti ˌtwɛnti naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 多次入境，有效到 2029 年 3 月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The same last day as my passport?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə seɪm læst deɪ æz maɪ ˈpæspɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 跟我的護照同一天到期？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sticker copies your passport end date.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈstɪkər ˈkɑpiz jɔr ˈpæspɔrt ɛnd deɪt./
dialogue.zh: 貼紙的到期日跟著你的護照走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And each stay can be six months long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd iʧ steɪ kæn bi sɪks mʌnθs lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 而且每一次入境可以待六個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But your plan is twelve days, remember?
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt jɔr plæn ɪz twɛlv deɪz rɪˈmɛmbər./
dialogue.zh: 不過你的計畫是十二天，記得吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve, with one hockey game inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv wɪð wʌn ˈhɑki ɡeɪm ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 十二天，其中有一場冰球賽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: October ten, you said, and I heard it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑkˈtoʊbər tɛn ju sɛd ænd aɪ hɜrd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你說了 10 月 10 號，我記起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can go again next year, no new visa.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn ɡoʊ əˈɡɛn nɛkst jɪr noʊ nu ˈvizə./
dialogue.zh: 明年我還能再去，不用辦新簽證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the cat a small gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə kæt ə smɔl ɡɪft./
dialogue.zh: 記得幫貓帶一份小禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small gift for her, soup for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl ɡɪft fɔr hɜr sup fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 給牠一份小禮，給你一鍋湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The market soup, yes, bring two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɑrkɪt sup jɛs brɪŋ tu./
dialogue.zh: 就是市集那鍋湯，記得帶兩份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now this slip, do I still need it?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðɪs slɪp du aɪ stɪl nid ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那這張藍色單子，我還要留嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it till the trip is over.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt tɪl ðə trɪp ɪz ˈoʊvər./
dialogue.zh: 留到這趟旅行結束為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then it joins the passport on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt dʒɔɪnz ðə ˈpæspɔrt ɑn ðə ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 那就讓它跟護照一起上架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not the drawer, the shelf, higher up.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ðə drɔr ðə ʃɛlf ˈhaɪər ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 不要抽屜，放架子，高一點的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Higher, so my wife cannot move it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhaɪər soʊ maɪ waɪf ˈkænɑt muv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 放高一點，我太太就搬不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She moved the whole folder today, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi muvd ðə hoʊl ˈfoʊldər təˈdeɪ ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不過她今天已經搬過一次文件夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six weeks more, then one packing day.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks wikz mɔr ðɛn wʌn ˈpækɪŋ deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 再六週，然後是收拾行李的那一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The socks at the bottom of the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɑks æt ðə ˈbɑtəm ʌv ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 襪子要塞在行李箱最底層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I remember, the officer taught me that.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ rɪˈmɛmbər ði ˈɔfəsər tɔt mi ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 我記得，是窗口那位說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then nothing stands between you and Toronto.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈnʌθɪŋ stændz bɪˈtwin ju ænd təˈrɑntoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那就再沒有東西擋在你跟多倫多之間了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I should thank that lady at counter six.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ʃʊd θæŋk ðə ˈleɪdi æt ˈkaʊntər sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 我得好好謝謝六號櫃台那一位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the one with the warm cloth, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ði wʌn wɪð ðə wɔrm klɔθ tu./
dialogue.zh: 也要謝謝給我那條溫布的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten fingers, one new photo, one sticker.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈfɪŋɡərz wʌn nu ˈfoʊtoʊ wʌn ˈstɪkər./
dialogue.zh: 十根手指、一張新照片、一張貼紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And you slept well through all of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ju slɛpt wɛl θru ɔl ʌv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 而這一路的等待，你都睡得挺好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight I sleep without the folder.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt aɪ slip wɪˈðaʊt ðə ˈfoʊldər./
dialogue.zh: 今晚我不帶著文件夾睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The passport is home, so close your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpæspɔrt ɪz hoʊm soʊ kloʊz jɔr aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 護照已經回家，所以閉上眼睛吧。
